   138→// writeTaskCheckpointEntries writes task-specific checkpoint entries and returns the task metadata path.
   139→func (s *GitStore) writeTaskCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   140→	taskPath := basePath + "tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID + "/"
   141→
   142→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   143→		return s.writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   144→	}
   145→	return s.writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   146→}
   147→
   148→// writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint writes an incremental checkpoint file during task execution.
   149→func (s *GitStore) writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   150→	incData, err := redact.JSONLBytes(opts.IncrementalData)
   151→	if err != nil {
   152→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to redact incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   153→	}
   154→	checkpoint := incrementalCheckpointData{
   155→		Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   156→		ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   157→		Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   158→		Data:      incData,
   159→	}
   160→	cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   161→	if err != nil {
   162→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   163→	}
   164→	cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   165→	if err != nil {
   166→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   170→	cpPath := taskPath + "checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   171→	entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   172→		Name: cpPath,
   173→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   174→		Hash: cpBlobHash,
   175→	}
   176→	return cpPath, nil
   177→}
   178→
   179→// writeFinalTaskCheckpoint writes the final checkpoint.json and subagent transcript.
   180→func (s *GitStore) writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   181→	checkpoint := taskCheckpointData{
   182→		SessionID:      opts.SessionID,
   183→		ToolUseID:      opts.ToolUseID,
   184→		CheckpointUUID: opts.CheckpointUUID,
   185→		AgentID:        opts.AgentID,
   186→	}
   187→	checkpointData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   188→	if err != nil {
   189→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal task checkpoint: %w", err)
   190→	}
   191→	blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, checkpointData)
   192→	if err != nil {
   193→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create task checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   194→	}
   195→
   196→	checkpointFile := taskPath + "checkpoint.json"
   197→	entries[checkpointFile] = object.TreeEntry{
   198→		Name: checkpointFile,
   199→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   200→		Hash: blobHash,
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Write subagent transcript if available
   204→	if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   205→		agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath)
   206→		if readErr == nil {
   207→			agentContent, readErr = redact.JSONLBytes(agentContent)
   208→		}
   209→		if readErr == nil {
   210→			agentBlobHash, agentBlobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent)
   211→			if agentBlobErr == nil {
   212→				agentPath := taskPath + "agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   213→				entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   214→					Name: agentPath,
   215→					Mode: filemode.Regular,
   216→					Hash: agentBlobHash,
   217→				}
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	// Return task path without trailing slash
   223→	return taskPath[:len(taskPath)-1], nil
   224→}
   225→
   226→// writeStandardCheckpointEntries writes session files to numbered subdirectories and
   227→// maintains a CheckpointSummary at the root level with aggregated statistics.
   228→//
   229→// Structure:
   230→//
   231→//	basePath/
   232→//	├── metadata.json         # CheckpointSummary (aggregated stats)
   233→//	├── 1/                    # First session
   234→//	│   ├── metadata.json     # CommittedMetadata (session-specific, includes initial_attribution)
   235→//	│   ├── full.jsonl
   236→//	│   ├── prompt.txt
   237→//	│   ├── context.md
   238→//	│   └── content_hash.txt
   239→//	├── 2/                    # Second session
   240→//	└── ...
   241→func (s *GitStore) writeStandardCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   242→	// Read existing summary to get current session count
   243→	var existingSummary *CheckpointSummary
   244→	metadataPath := basePath + paths.MetadataFileName
   245→	if entry, exists := entries[metadataPath]; exists {
   246→		existing, err := s.readSummaryFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   247→		if err == nil {
   248→			existingSummary = existing
   249→		}
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	// Determine session index: reuse existing slot if session ID matches, otherwise append
   253→	sessionIndex := s.findSessionIndex(basePath, existingSummary, entries, opts.SessionID)
   254→
   255→	// Write session files to numbered subdirectory
   256→	sessionPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/", basePath, sessionIndex)
   257→	sessionFilePaths, err := s.writeSessionToSubdirectory(opts, sessionPath, entries)
   258→	if err != nil {
   259→		return err
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	// Copy additional metadata files from directory if specified (to session subdirectory)
   263→	if opts.MetadataDir != "" {
   264→		if err := s.copyMetadataDir(opts.MetadataDir, sessionPath, entries); err != nil {
   265→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy metadata directory: %w", err)
   266→		}
   267→	}
   268→
   269→	// Build the sessions array
   270→	var sessions []SessionFilePaths
   271→	if existingSummary != nil {
   272→		sessions = make([]SessionFilePaths, max(len(existingSummary.Sessions), sessionIndex+1))
   273→		copy(sessions, existingSummary.Sessions)
   274→	} else {
   275→		sessions = make([]SessionFilePaths, 1)
   276→	}
   277→	sessions[sessionIndex] = sessionFilePaths
   278→
   279→	// Update root metadata.json with CheckpointSummary
   280→	return s.writeCheckpointSummary(opts, basePath, entries, sessions)
   281→}
   282→
   283→// writeSessionToSubdirectory writes a single session's files to a numbered subdirectory.
   284→// Returns the absolute file paths from the git tree root for the sessions map.
   285→func (s *GitStore) writeSessionToSubdirectory(opts WriteCommittedOptions, sessionPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (SessionFilePaths, error) {
   286→	filePaths := SessionFilePaths{}
   287→
   288→	// Clear any existing entries at this path so stale files from a previous
   289→	// write (e.g. prompt.txt, context.md) don't persist on overwrite.
   290→	for key := range entries {
   291→		if strings.HasPrefix(key, sessionPath) {
   292→			delete(entries, key)
   293→		}
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	// Write transcript
   297→	if err := s.writeTranscript(opts, sessionPath, entries); err != nil {
   298→		return filePaths, err
   299→	}
   300→	filePaths.Transcript = "/" + sessionPath + paths.TranscriptFileName
   301→	filePaths.ContentHash = "/" + sessionPath + paths.ContentHashFileName
   302→
   303→	// Write prompts
   304→	if len(opts.Prompts) > 0 {
   305→		promptContent := redact.String(strings.Join(opts.Prompts, "\n\n---\n\n"))
   306→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(promptContent))
   307→		if err != nil {
   308→			return filePaths, err
   309→		}
   310→		entries[sessionPath+paths.PromptFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   311→			Name: sessionPath + paths.PromptFileName,
   312→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   313→			Hash: blobHash,
   314→		}
   315→		filePaths.Prompt = "/" + sessionPath + paths.PromptFileName
   316→	}
   317→
   318→	// Write context
   319→	if len(opts.Context) > 0 {
   320→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, redact.Bytes(opts.Context))
   321→		if err != nil {
   322→			return filePaths, err
   323→		}
   324→		entries[sessionPath+paths.ContextFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   325→			Name: sessionPath + paths.ContextFileName,
   326→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   327→			Hash: blobHash,
   328→		}
   329→		filePaths.Context = "/" + sessionPath + paths.ContextFileName
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	// Write session-level metadata.json (CommittedMetadata with all fields including initial_attribution)
   333→	sessionMetadata := CommittedMetadata{
   334→		CheckpointID:                opts.CheckpointID,
   335→		SessionID:                   opts.SessionID,
   336→		Strategy:                    opts.Strategy,
   337→		CreatedAt:                   time.Now().UTC(),
   338→		Branch:                      opts.Branch,
   339→		CheckpointsCount:            opts.CheckpointsCount,
   340→		FilesTouched:                opts.FilesTouched,
   341→		Agent:                       opts.Agent,
   342→		IsTask:                      opts.IsTask,
   343→		ToolUseID:                   opts.ToolUseID,
   344→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: opts.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   345→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   opts.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   346→		TranscriptLinesAtStart:      opts.CheckpointTranscriptStart, // Deprecated: kept for backward compat
   347→		TokenUsage:                  opts.TokenUsage,
   348→		InitialAttribution:          opts.InitialAttribution,
   349→		Summary:                     opts.Summary,
   350→		CLIVersion:                  buildinfo.Version,
   351→		TranscriptPath:              opts.SessionTranscriptPath,
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(sessionMetadata, "", "  ")
   355→	if err != nil {
   356→		return filePaths, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session metadata: %w", err)
   357→	}
   358→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   359→	if err != nil {
   360→		return filePaths, err
   361→	}
   362→	entries[sessionPath+paths.MetadataFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   363→		Name: sessionPath + paths.MetadataFileName,
   364→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   365→		Hash: metadataHash,
   366→	}
   367→	filePaths.Metadata = "/" + sessionPath + paths.MetadataFileName
   368→
   369→	return filePaths, nil
   370→}
   371→
   372→// writeCheckpointSummary writes the root-level CheckpointSummary with aggregated statistics.
   373→// sessions is the complete sessions array (already built by the caller).
   374→func (s *GitStore) writeCheckpointSummary(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry, sessions []SessionFilePaths) error {
   375→	checkpointsCount, filesTouched, tokenUsage, err :=
   376→		s.reaggregateFromEntries(basePath, len(sessions), entries)
   377→	if err != nil {
   378→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to aggregate session stats: %w", err)
   379→	}
   380→
   381→	summary := CheckpointSummary{
   382→		CheckpointID:     opts.CheckpointID,
   383→		CLIVersion:       buildinfo.Version,
   384→		Strategy:         opts.Strategy,
   385→		Branch:           opts.Branch,
   386→		CheckpointsCount: checkpointsCount,
   387→		FilesTouched:     filesTouched,
   388→		Sessions:         sessions,
   389→		TokenUsage:       tokenUsage,
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(summary, "", "  ")
   393→	if err != nil {
   394→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal checkpoint summary: %w", err)
   395→	}
   396→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   397→	if err != nil {
   398→		return err
   399→	}
   400→	entries[basePath+paths.MetadataFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   401→		Name: basePath + paths.MetadataFileName,
   402→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   403→		Hash: metadataHash,
   404→	}
   405→	return nil
   406→}
   407→
   408→// findSessionIndex returns the index of an existing session with the given ID,
   409→// or the next available index if not found. This prevents duplicate session entries.
   410→func (s *GitStore) findSessionIndex(basePath string, existingSummary *CheckpointSummary, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry, sessionID string) int {
   411→	if existingSummary == nil {
   412→		return 0
   413→	}
   414→	for i := range len(existingSummary.Sessions) {
   415→		path := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/%s", basePath, i, paths.MetadataFileName)
   416→		if entry, exists := entries[path]; exists {
   417→			meta, err := s.readMetadataFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   418→			if err != nil {
   419→				logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to read session metadata during dedup check",
   420→					slog.Int("session_index", i),
   421→					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   422→					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   423→				)
   424→				continue
   425→			}
   426→			if meta.SessionID == sessionID {
   427→				return i
   428→			}
   429→		}
   430→	}
   431→	return len(existingSummary.Sessions)
   432→}
   433→
   434→// reaggregateFromEntries reads all session metadata from the entries map and
   435→// reaggregates CheckpointsCount, FilesTouched, and TokenUsage.
   436→func (s *GitStore) reaggregateFromEntries(basePath string, sessionCount int, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (int, []string, *agent.TokenUsage, error) {
   437→	var totalCount int
   438→	var allFiles []string
   439→	var totalTokens *agent.TokenUsage
   440→
   441→	for i := range sessionCount {
   442→		path := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/%s", basePath, i, paths.MetadataFileName)
   443→		entry, exists := entries[path]
   444→		if !exists {
   445→			return 0, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("session %d metadata not found at %s", i, path)
   446→		}
   447→		meta, err := s.readMetadataFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   448→		if err != nil {
   449→			return 0, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session %d metadata: %w", i, err)
   450→		}
   451→		totalCount += meta.CheckpointsCount
   452→		allFiles = mergeFilesTouched(allFiles, meta.FilesTouched)
   453→		totalTokens = aggregateTokenUsage(totalTokens, meta.TokenUsage)
   454→	}
   455→
   456→	return totalCount, allFiles, totalTokens, nil
   457→}
   458→
   459→// readJSONFromBlob reads JSON from a blob hash and decodes it to the given type.
   460→func readJSONFromBlob[T any](repo *git.Repository, hash plumbing.Hash) (*T, error) {
   461→	blob, err := repo.BlobObject(hash)
   462→	if err != nil {
   463→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob: %w", err)
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	reader, err := blob.Reader()
   467→	if err != nil {
   468→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob reader: %w", err)
   469→	}
   470→	defer reader.Close()
   471→
   472→	var result T
   473→	if err := json.NewDecoder(reader).Decode(&result); err != nil {
   474→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode: %w", err)
   475→	}
   476→
   477→	return &result, nil
   478→}
   479→
   480→// readSummaryFromBlob reads CheckpointSummary from a blob hash.
   481→func (s *GitStore) readSummaryFromBlob(hash plumbing.Hash) (*CheckpointSummary, error) {
   482→	return readJSONFromBlob[CheckpointSummary](s.repo, hash)
   483→}
   484→
   485→// aggregateTokenUsage sums two TokenUsage structs.
   486→// Returns nil if both inputs are nil.
   487→func aggregateTokenUsage(a, b *agent.TokenUsage) *agent.TokenUsage {
   488→	if a == nil && b == nil {
   489→		return nil
   490→	}
   491→	result := &agent.TokenUsage{}
   492→	if a != nil {
   493→		result.InputTokens = a.InputTokens
   494→		result.CacheCreationTokens = a.CacheCreationTokens
   495→		result.CacheReadTokens = a.CacheReadTokens
   496→		result.OutputTokens = a.OutputTokens
   497→		result.APICallCount = a.APICallCount
   498→	}
   499→	if b != nil {
   500→		result.InputTokens += b.InputTokens
   501→		result.CacheCreationTokens += b.CacheCreationTokens
   502→		result.CacheReadTokens += b.CacheReadTokens
   503→		result.OutputTokens += b.OutputTokens
   504→		result.APICallCount += b.APICallCount
   505→	}
   506→	return result
   507→}
   508→
   509→// writeTranscript writes the transcript file from in-memory content or file path.
   510→// If the transcript exceeds MaxChunkSize, it's split into multiple chunk files.
   511→func (s *GitStore) writeTranscript(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   512→	transcript := opts.Transcript
   513→	if len(transcript) == 0 && opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   514→		var readErr error
   515→		transcript, readErr = os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath)
   516→		if readErr != nil {
   517→			// Non-fatal: transcript may not exist yet
   518→			transcript = nil
   519→		}
   520→	}
   521→	if len(transcript) == 0 {
   522→		return nil
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	// Redact secrets before chunking so content hash reflects redacted content
   526→	transcript, err := redact.JSONLBytes(transcript)
   527→	if err != nil {
   528→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to redact transcript secrets: %w", err)
   529→	}
   530→
   531→	// Chunk the transcript if it's too large
   532→	chunks, err := agent.ChunkTranscript(transcript, opts.Agent)
   533→	if err != nil {
   534→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to chunk transcript: %w", err)
   535→	}
   536→
   537→	// Write chunk files
   538→	for i, chunk := range chunks {
   539→		chunkPath := basePath + agent.ChunkFileName(paths.TranscriptFileName, i)
   540→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, chunk)
   541→		if err != nil {
   542→			return err
   543→		}
   544→		entries[chunkPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   545→			Name: chunkPath,
   546→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   547→			Hash: blobHash,
   548→		}
   549→	}
   550→
   551→	// Content hash for deduplication (hash of full transcript)
   552→	contentHash := fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256(transcript))
   553→	hashBlob, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(contentHash))
   554→	if err != nil {
   555→		return err
   556→	}
   557→	entries[basePath+paths.ContentHashFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   558→		Name: basePath + paths.ContentHashFileName,
   559→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   560→		Hash: hashBlob,
   561→	}
   562→	return nil
   563→}
   564→
   565→// mergeFilesTouched combines two file lists, removing duplicates.
   566→func mergeFilesTouched(existing, additional []string) []string {
   567→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   568→	var result []string
   569→
   570→	for _, f := range existing {
   571→		if !seen[f] {
   572→			seen[f] = true
   573→			result = append(result, f)
   574→		}
   575→	}
   576→	for _, f := range additional {
   577→		if !seen[f] {
   578→			seen[f] = true
   579→			result = append(result, f)
   580→		}
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	sort.Strings(result)
   584→	return result
   585→}
   586→
   587→// readMetadataFromBlob reads CommittedMetadata from a blob hash.
   588→func (s *GitStore) readMetadataFromBlob(hash plumbing.Hash) (*CommittedMetadata, error) {
   589→	return readJSONFromBlob[CommittedMetadata](s.repo, hash)
   590→}
   591→
   592→// buildCommitMessage constructs the commit message with proper trailers.
   593→// The commit subject is always "Checkpoint: <id>" for consistency.
   594→// If CommitSubject is provided (e.g., for task checkpoints), it's included in the body.
   595→func (s *GitStore) buildCommitMessage(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskMetadataPath string) string {
   596→	var commitMsg strings.Builder
   597→
   598→	// Subject line is always the checkpoint ID for consistent formatting
   599→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoint: %s\n\n", opts.CheckpointID))
   600→
   601→	// Include custom description in body if provided (e.g., task checkpoint details)
   602→	if opts.CommitSubject != "" {
   603→		commitMsg.WriteString(opts.CommitSubject + "\n\n")
   604→	}
   605→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.SessionTrailerKey, opts.SessionID))
   606→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.StrategyTrailerKey, opts.Strategy))
   607→	if opts.Agent != "" {
   608→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.AgentTrailerKey, opts.Agent))
   609→	}
   610→	if opts.EphemeralBranch != "" {
   611→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.EphemeralBranchTrailerKey, opts.EphemeralBranch))
   612→	}
   613→	if taskMetadataPath != "" {
   614→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataPath))
   615→	}
   616→
   617→	return commitMsg.String()
   618→}
   619→
   620→// incrementalCheckpointData represents an incremental checkpoint during subagent execution.
   621→// This mirrors strategy.SubagentCheckpoint but avoids import cycles.
   622→type incrementalCheckpointData struct {
   623→	Type      string          `json:"type"`
   624→	ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   625→	Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   626→	Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   627→}
   628→
   629→// taskCheckpointData represents a final task checkpoint.
   630→// This mirrors strategy.TaskCheckpoint but avoids import cycles.
   631→type taskCheckpointData struct {
   632→	SessionID      string `json:"session_id"`
   633→	ToolUseID      string `json:"tool_use_id"`
   634→	CheckpointUUID string `json:"checkpoint_uuid"`
   635→	AgentID        string `json:"agent_id,omitempty"`
   636→}
   637→
   638→// ReadCommitted reads a committed checkpoint's summary by ID from the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
   639→// Returns only the CheckpointSummary (paths + aggregated stats), not actual content.
   640→// Use ReadSessionContent to read actual transcript/prompts/context.
   641→// Returns nil, nil if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   642→//
   643→// The storage format uses numbered subdirectories for each session (0-based):
   644→//
   645→//	<checkpoint-id>/
   646→//	├── metadata.json      # CheckpointSummary with sessions map
   647→//	├── 0/                 # First session
   648→//	│   ├── metadata.json  # Session-specific metadata
   649→//	│   └── full.jsonl     # Transcript
   650→//	├── 1/                 # Second session
   651→//	└── ...
   652→func (s *GitStore) ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (*CheckpointSummary, error) {
   653→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   654→
   655→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   656→	if err != nil {
   657→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // No sessions branch means no checkpoint exists
   658→	}
   659→
   660→	checkpointPath := checkpointID.Path()
   661→	checkpointTree, err := tree.Tree(checkpointPath)
   662→	if err != nil {
   663→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Checkpoint directory not found
   664→	}
   665→
   666→	// Read root metadata.json as CheckpointSummary
   667→	metadataFile, err := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName)
   668→	if err != nil {
   669→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // metadata.json not found
   670→	}
   671→
   672→	content, err := metadataFile.Contents()
   673→	if err != nil {
   674→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read metadata.json: %w", err)
   675→	}
   676→
   677→	var summary CheckpointSummary
   678→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &summary); err != nil {
   679→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse metadata.json: %w", err)
   680→	}
   681→
   682→	return &summary, nil
   683→}
   684→
   685→// ReadSessionContent reads the actual content for a specific session within a checkpoint.
   686→// sessionIndex is 0-based (0 for first session, 1 for second, etc.).
   687→// Returns the session's metadata, transcript, prompts, and context.
   688→// Returns an error if the checkpoint or session doesn't exist.
   689→func (s *GitStore) ReadSessionContent(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionIndex int) (*SessionContent, error) {
   690→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   691→
   692→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   693→	if err != nil {
   694→		return nil, ErrCheckpointNotFound
   695→	}
   696→
   697→	checkpointPath := checkpointID.Path()
   698→	checkpointTree, err := tree.Tree(checkpointPath)
   699→	if err != nil {
   700→		return nil, ErrCheckpointNotFound
   701→	}
   702→
   703→	// Get the session subdirectory
   704→	sessionDir := strconv.Itoa(sessionIndex)
   705→	sessionTree, err := checkpointTree.Tree(sessionDir)
   706→	if err != nil {
   707→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("session %d not found: %w", sessionIndex, err)
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	result := &SessionContent{}
   711→
   712→	// Read session-specific metadata
   713→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   714→	if metadataFile, fileErr := sessionTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   715→		if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   716→			if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &result.Metadata); jsonErr == nil {
   717→				agentType = result.Metadata.Agent
   718→			}
   719→		}
   720→	}
   721→
   722→	// Read transcript
   723→	if transcript, transcriptErr := readTranscriptFromTree(sessionTree, agentType); transcriptErr == nil && transcript != nil {
   724→		result.Transcript = transcript
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	// Read prompts
   728→	if file, fileErr := sessionTree.File(paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   729→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   730→			result.Prompts = content
   731→		}
   732→	}
   733→
   734→	// Read context
   735→	if file, fileErr := sessionTree.File(paths.ContextFileName); fileErr == nil {
   736→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   737→			result.Context = content
   738→		}
   739→	}
   740→
   741→	return result, nil
   742→}
   743→
   744→// ReadLatestSessionContent is a convenience method that reads the latest session's content.
   745→// This is equivalent to ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, len(summary.Sessions)-1).
   746→func (s *GitStore) ReadLatestSessionContent(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (*SessionContent, error) {
   747→	summary, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
   748→	if err != nil {
   749→		return nil, err
   750→	}
   751→	if summary == nil {
   752→		return nil, ErrCheckpointNotFound
   753→	}
   754→	if len(summary.Sessions) == 0 {
   755→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint has no sessions: %s", checkpointID)
   756→	}
   757→
   758→	latestIndex := len(summary.Sessions) - 1
   759→	return s.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, latestIndex)
   760→}
   761→
   762→// ReadSessionContentByID reads a session's content by its session ID.
   763→// This is useful when you have the session ID but don't know its index within the checkpoint.
   764→// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   765→// Returns an error if no session with the given ID exists in the checkpoint.
   766→func (s *GitStore) ReadSessionContentByID(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string) (*SessionContent, error) {
   767→	summary, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
   768→	if err != nil {
   769→		return nil, err
   770→	}
   771→	if summary == nil {
   772→		return nil, ErrCheckpointNotFound
   773→	}
   774→
   775→	// Iterate through sessions to find the one with matching session ID
   776→	for i := range len(summary.Sessions) {
   777→		content, readErr := s.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, i)
   778→		if readErr != nil {
   779→			continue
   780→		}
   781→		if content != nil && content.Metadata.SessionID == sessionID {
   782→			return content, nil
   783→		}
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	return nil, fmt.Errorf("session %q not found in checkpoint %s", sessionID, checkpointID)
   787→}
   788→
   789→// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints from the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
   790→// Scans sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/ directories containing metadata.json.
   791→//
   792→
   793→func (s *GitStore) ListCommitted(ctx context.Context) ([]CommittedInfo, error) {
   794→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   795→
   796→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   797→	if err != nil {
   798→		return []CommittedInfo{}, nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions branch means empty list
   799→	}
   800→
   801→	var checkpoints []CommittedInfo
   802→
   803→	// Scan sharded structure: <2-char-prefix>/<remaining-id>/metadata.json
   804→	for _, bucketEntry := range tree.Entries {
   805→		if bucketEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   806→			continue
   807→		}
   808→		// Bucket should be 2 hex chars
   809→		if len(bucketEntry.Name) != 2 {
   810→			continue
   811→		}
   812→
   813→		bucketTree, treeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(bucketEntry.Hash)
   814→		if treeErr != nil {
   815→			continue
   816→		}
   817→
   818→		// Each entry in the bucket is the remaining part of the checkpoint ID
   819→		for _, checkpointEntry := range bucketTree.Entries {
   820→			if checkpointEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   821→				continue
   822→			}
   823→
   824→			checkpointTree, cpTreeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(checkpointEntry.Hash)
   825→			if cpTreeErr != nil {
   826→				continue
   827→			}
   828→
   829→			// Reconstruct checkpoint ID: <bucket><remaining>
   830→			checkpointIDStr := bucketEntry.Name + checkpointEntry.Name
   831→			checkpointID, cpIDErr := id.NewCheckpointID(checkpointIDStr)
   832→			if cpIDErr != nil {
   833→				// Skip invalid checkpoint IDs (shouldn't happen with our own data)
   834→				continue
   835→			}
   836→
   837→			info := CommittedInfo{
   838→				CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   839→			}
   840→
   841→			// Get details from root metadata file (CheckpointSummary format)
   842→			if metadataFile, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   843→				if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   844→					var summary CheckpointSummary
   845→					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &summary); err == nil {
   846→						info.CheckpointsCount = summary.CheckpointsCount
   847→						info.FilesTouched = summary.FilesTouched
   848→						info.SessionCount = len(summary.Sessions)
   849→
   850→						// Read session metadata from latest session to get Agent, SessionID, CreatedAt
   851→						if len(summary.Sessions) > 0 {
   852→							latestIndex := len(summary.Sessions) - 1
   853→							latestDir := strconv.Itoa(latestIndex)
   854→							if sessionTree, treeErr := checkpointTree.Tree(latestDir); treeErr == nil {
   855→								if sessionMetadataFile, smErr := sessionTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); smErr == nil {
   856→									if sessionContent, scErr := sessionMetadataFile.Contents(); scErr == nil {
   857→										var sessionMetadata CommittedMetadata
   858→										if json.Unmarshal([]byte(sessionContent), &sessionMetadata) == nil {
   859→											info.Agent = sessionMetadata.Agent
   860→											info.SessionID = sessionMetadata.SessionID
   861→											info.CreatedAt = sessionMetadata.CreatedAt
   862→										}
   863→									}
   864→								}
   865→							}
   866→						}
   867→					}
   868→				}
   869→			}
   870→
   871→			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, info)
   872→		}
   873→	}
   874→
   875→	// Sort by time (most recent first)
   876→	sort.Slice(checkpoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   877→		return checkpoints[i].CreatedAt.After(checkpoints[j].CreatedAt)
   878→	})
   879→
   880→	return checkpoints, nil
   881→}
   882→
   883→// GetTranscript retrieves the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
   884→// Returns the latest session's transcript.
   885→func (s *GitStore) GetTranscript(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, error) {
   886→	content, err := s.ReadLatestSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID)
   887→	if err != nil {
   888→		return nil, err
   889→	}
   890→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   891→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   892→	}
   893→	return content.Transcript, nil
   894→}
   895→
   896→// GetSessionLog retrieves the session transcript and session ID for a checkpoint.
   897→// This is the primary method for looking up session logs by checkpoint ID.
   898→// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   899→// Returns ErrNoTranscript if the checkpoint exists but has no transcript.
   900→func (s *GitStore) GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error) {
   901→	content, err := s.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), cpID)
   902→	if err != nil {
   903→		if errors.Is(err, ErrCheckpointNotFound) {
   904→			return nil, "", ErrCheckpointNotFound
   905→		}
   906→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   907→	}
   908→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   909→		return nil, "", ErrNoTranscript
   910→	}
   911→	return content.Transcript, content.Metadata.SessionID, nil
   912→}

   914→// LookupSessionLog is a convenience function that opens the repository and retrieves

   928→// UpdateSummary updates the summary field in the latest session's metadata.
   929→// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   930→func (s *GitStore) UpdateSummary(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, summary *Summary) error {
   931→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   932→
   933→	// Ensure sessions branch exists
   934→	if err := s.ensureSessionsBranch(); err != nil {
   935→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to ensure sessions branch: %w", err)
   936→	}
   937→
   938→	// Get current branch tip and flatten tree
   939→	ref, entries, err := s.getSessionsBranchEntries()
   940→	if err != nil {
   941→		return err
   942→	}
   943→
   944→	// Read root CheckpointSummary to find the latest session
   945→	basePath := checkpointID.Path() + "/"
   946→	rootMetadataPath := basePath + paths.MetadataFileName
   947→	entry, exists := entries[rootMetadataPath]
   948→	if !exists {
   949→		return ErrCheckpointNotFound
   950→	}
   951→
   952→	checkpointSummary, err := s.readSummaryFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   953→	if err != nil {
   954→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint summary: %w", err)
   955→	}
   956→
   957→	// Find the latest session's metadata path (0-based indexing)
   958→	latestIndex := len(checkpointSummary.Sessions) - 1
   959→	sessionMetadataPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/%s", basePath, latestIndex, paths.MetadataFileName)
   960→	sessionEntry, exists := entries[sessionMetadataPath]
   961→	if !exists {
   962→		return fmt.Errorf("session metadata not found at %s", sessionMetadataPath)
   963→	}
   964→
   965→	// Read and update session metadata
   966→	existingMetadata, err := s.readMetadataFromBlob(sessionEntry.Hash)
   967→	if err != nil {
   968→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read session metadata: %w", err)
   969→	}
   970→
   971→	// Update the summary
   972→	existingMetadata.Summary = summary
   973→
   974→	// Write updated session metadata
   975→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(existingMetadata, "", "  ")
   976→	if err != nil {
   977→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal metadata: %w", err)
   978→	}
   979→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   980→	if err != nil {
   981→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create metadata blob: %w", err)
   982→	}
   983→	entries[sessionMetadataPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   984→		Name: sessionMetadataPath,
   985→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   986→		Hash: metadataHash,
   987→	}
   988→
   989→	// Build and commit
   990→	newTreeHash, err := BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   991→	if err != nil {
   992→		return err
   993→	}
   994→
   995→	authorName, authorEmail := getGitAuthorFromRepo(s.repo)
   996→	commitMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Update summary for checkpoint %s (session: %s)", checkpointID, existingMetadata.SessionID)
   997→	newCommitHash, err := s.createCommit(newTreeHash, ref.Hash(), commitMsg, authorName, authorEmail)
   998→	if err != nil {
   999→		return err
  1000→	}
  1001→
  1002→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
  1003→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, newCommitHash)
  1004→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
  1005→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)
  1006→	}
  1007→
  1008→	return nil
  1009→}

  1011→// ensureSessionsBranch ensures the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch exists.
  1012→func (s *GitStore) ensureSessionsBranch() error {
  1013→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
  1014→	_, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)

  1031→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)

  1033→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)

  1038→// getSessionsBranchTree returns the tree object for the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
  1039→// Falls back to origin/entire/checkpoints/v1 if the local branch doesn't exist.
  1040→func (s *GitStore) getSessionsBranchTree() (*object.Tree, error) {
  1041→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
  1042→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1043→	if err != nil {
  1044→		// Local branch doesn't exist, try remote-tracking branch
  1045→		remoteRefName := plumbing.NewRemoteReferenceName("origin", paths.MetadataBranchName)
  1046→		ref, err = s.repo.Reference(remoteRefName, true)
  1047→		if err != nil {
  1048→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions branch not found: %w", err)
  1049→		}
  1050→	}
  1051→
  1052→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
  1053→	if err != nil {
  1054→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
  1055→	}
  1056→
  1057→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
  1058→	if err != nil {
  1059→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
  1060→	}
  1061→
  1062→	return tree, nil
  1063→}

  1065→// CreateBlobFromContent creates a blob object from in-memory content.
  1066→// Exported for use by strategy package (session_test.go)
  1067→func CreateBlobFromContent(repo *git.Repository, content []byte) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
  1068→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
  1069→	obj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
  1070→	obj.SetSize(int64(len(content)))
  1071→
  1072→	writer, err := obj.Writer()
  1073→	if err != nil {
  1074→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get object writer: %w", err)
  1075→	}
  1076→
  1077→	_, err = writer.Write(content)
  1078→	if err != nil {
  1079→		_ = writer.Close()
  1080→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content: %w", err)
  1081→	}
  1082→	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
  1083→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to close blob writer: %w", err)
  1084→	}
  1085→
  1086→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
  1087→	if err != nil {
  1088→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob object: %w", err)
  1089→	}
  1090→	return hash, nil
  1091→}

  1093→// copyMetadataDir copies all files from a directory to the checkpoint path.
  1094→// Used to include additional metadata files like task checkpoints, subagent transcripts, etc.
  1095→func (s *GitStore) copyMetadataDir(metadataDir, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
  1096→	err := filepath.Walk(metadataDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
  1097→		if err != nil {
  1098→			return err
  1099→		}
  1100→		if info.IsDir() {
  1101→			return nil
  1102→		}
  1103→
  1104→		// Skip symlinks to prevent reading files outside the metadata directory.
  1105→		// A symlink could point to sensitive files (e.g., /etc/passwd) which would
  1106→		// then be captured in the checkpoint and stored in git history.
  1107→		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
  1108→			return nil
  1109→		}
  1110→
  1111→		// Get relative path within metadata dir
  1112→		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(metadataDir, path)
  1113→		if err != nil {
  1114→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get relative path for %s: %w", path, err)
  1115→		}
  1116→
  1117→		// Prevent path traversal via symlinks pointing outside the metadata dir
  1118→		if strings.HasPrefix(relPath, "..") {
  1119→			return fmt.Errorf("path traversal detected: %s", relPath)
  1120→		}
  1121→
  1122→		// Create blob from file with secrets redaction
  1123→		blobHash, mode, err := createRedactedBlobFromFile(s.repo, path, relPath)
  1124→		if err != nil {
  1125→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob for %s: %w", path, err)
  1126→		}
  1127→
  1128→		// Store at checkpoint path
  1129→		fullPath := basePath + relPath
  1130→		entries[fullPath] = object.TreeEntry{
  1131→			Name: fullPath,
  1132→			Mode: mode,
  1133→			Hash: blobHash,
  1134→		}
  1135→
  1136→		return nil
  1137→	})
  1138→	if err != nil {
  1139→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to walk metadata directory: %w", err)
  1140→	}
  1141→	return nil
  1142→}
  1143→
  1144→// createRedactedBlobFromFile reads a file, applies secrets redaction, and creates a git blob.
  1145→// JSONL files get JSONL-aware redaction; all other files get plain string redaction.
  1146→func createRedactedBlobFromFile(repo *git.Repository, filePath, treePath string) (plumbing.Hash, filemode.FileMode, error) {
  1147→	info, err := os.Stat(filePath)
  1148→	if err != nil {
  1149→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to stat file: %w", err)
  1150→	}
  1151→
  1152→	mode := filemode.Regular
  1153→	if info.Mode()&0o111 != 0 {
  1154→		mode = filemode.Executable
  1155→	}
  1156→
  1157→	content, err := os.ReadFile(filePath) //nolint:gosec // filePath comes from walking the metadata directory
  1158→	if err != nil {
  1159→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read file: %w", err)
  1160→	}
  1161→
  1162→	// Skip redaction for binary files — they can't contain text secrets and
  1163→	// running string replacement on them would corrupt the data.
  1164→	isBin, binErr := binary.IsBinary(bytes.NewReader(content))
  1165→	if binErr != nil || isBin {
  1166→		hash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(repo, content)
  1167→		if err != nil {
  1168→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob: %w", err)
  1169→		}
  1170→		return hash, mode, nil
  1171→	}
  1172→
  1173→	if strings.HasSuffix(treePath, ".jsonl") {
  1174→		content, err = redact.JSONLBytes(content)
  1175→		if err != nil {
  1176→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to redact secrets: %w", err)
  1177→		}
  1178→	} else {
  1179→		content = redact.Bytes(content)
  1180→	}
  1181→
  1182→	hash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(repo, content)
  1183→	if err != nil {
  1184→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob: %w", err)
  1185→	}
  1186→	return hash, mode, nil
  1187→}

  1189→// getGitAuthorFromRepo retrieves the git user.name and user.email from the repository config.
  1190→func getGitAuthorFromRepo(repo *git.Repository) (name, email string) {
  1191→	// Get repository config (includes local settings)
  1192→	cfg, err := repo.Config()
  1193→	if err == nil {
  1194→		name = cfg.User.Name
  1195→		email = cfg.User.Email
  1196→	}
  1197→
  1198→	// Provide sensible defaults if git user is not configured
  1199→	if name == "" {
  1200→		name = "Unknown"
  1201→	}
  1202→	if email == "" {
  1203→		email = "unknown@local"
  1204→	}
  1205→
  1206→	return name, email
  1207→}

  1209→// readTranscriptFromTree reads a transcript from a git tree, handling both chunked and non-chunked formats.
  1210→// It checks for chunk files first (.001, .002, etc.), then falls back to the base file.
  1211→// The agentType is used for reassembling chunks in the correct format.
  1212→func readTranscriptFromTree(tree *object.Tree, agentType agent.AgentType) ([]byte, error) {
  1213→	// Collect all transcript-related files
  1214→	var chunkFiles []string
  1215→	var hasBaseFile bool
  1216→
  1217→	for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
  1218→		if entry.Name == paths.TranscriptFileName || entry.Name == paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy {
  1219→			hasBaseFile = true
  1220→		}
  1221→		// Check for chunk files (full.jsonl.001, full.jsonl.002, etc.)
  1222→		if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name, paths.TranscriptFileName+".") {
  1223→			idx := agent.ParseChunkIndex(entry.Name, paths.TranscriptFileName)
  1224→			if idx > 0 {
  1225→				chunkFiles = append(chunkFiles, entry.Name)
  1226→			}
  1227→		}
  1228→	}
  1229→
  1230→	// If we have chunk files, read and reassemble them
  1231→	if len(chunkFiles) > 0 {
  1232→		// Sort chunk files by index
  1233→		chunkFiles = agent.SortChunkFiles(chunkFiles, paths.TranscriptFileName)
  1234→
  1235→		// Check if base file should be included as chunk 0.
  1236→		// NOTE: This assumes the chunking convention where the unsuffixed file
  1237→		// (full.jsonl) is chunk 0, and numbered files (.001, .002) are chunks 1+.
  1238→		if hasBaseFile {
  1239→			chunkFiles = append([]string{paths.TranscriptFileName}, chunkFiles...)
  1240→		}
  1241→
  1242→		var chunks [][]byte
  1243→		for _, chunkFile := range chunkFiles {
  1244→			file, err := tree.File(chunkFile)
  1245→			if err != nil {
  1246→				logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to read transcript chunk file from tree",
  1247→					slog.String("chunk_file", chunkFile),
  1248→					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1249→				)
  1250→				continue
  1251→			}
  1252→			content, err := file.Contents()
  1253→			if err != nil {
  1254→				logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to read transcript chunk contents",
  1255→					slog.String("chunk_file", chunkFile),
  1256→					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1257→				)
  1258→				continue
  1259→			}
  1260→			chunks = append(chunks, []byte(content))
  1261→		}
  1262→
  1263→		if len(chunks) > 0 {
  1264→			result, err := agent.ReassembleTranscript(chunks, agentType)
  1265→			if err != nil {
  1266→				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to reassemble transcript: %w", err)
  1267→			}
  1268→			return result, nil
  1269→		}
  1270→	}
  1271→
  1272→	// Fall back to reading base file (non-chunked or backwards compatibility)
  1273→	if file, err := tree.File(paths.TranscriptFileName); err == nil {
  1274→		if content, err := file.Contents(); err == nil {
  1275→			return []byte(content), nil
  1276→		}
  1277→	}
  1278→
  1279→	// Try legacy filename
  1280→	if file, err := tree.File(paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); err == nil {
  1281→		if content, err := file.Contents(); err == nil {
  1282→			return []byte(content), nil
  1283→		}
  1284→	}
  1285→
  1286→	return nil, nil
  1287→}

  1295→// GetCheckpointAuthor retrieves the author of a checkpoint from the entire/checkpoints/v1 commit history.
  1296→// Returns the author of the commit that introduced this checkpoint's metadata.json file.
  1297→// Returns empty Author if the checkpoint is not found or the sessions branch doesn't exist.
  1298→func (s *GitStore) GetCheckpointAuthor(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (Author, error) {
  1299→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
  1300→
  1301→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
  1302→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1303→	if err != nil {
  1304→		return Author{}, nil
  1305→	}
  1306→
  1307→	// Path to the checkpoint's metadata file
  1308→	metadataPath := checkpointID.Path() + "/" + paths.MetadataFileName
  1309→
  1310→	// Walk commit history looking for the commit that introduced this file
  1311→	iter, err := s.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
  1312→		From:  ref.Hash(),
  1313→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
  1314→	})
  1315→	if err != nil {
  1316→		return Author{}, nil
  1317→	}
  1318→	defer iter.Close()
  1319→
  1320→	var author Author
  1321→	var foundCommit *object.Commit
  1322→
  1323→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
  1324→		tree, treeErr := c.Tree()
  1325→		if treeErr != nil {
  1326→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Skip commits we can't read, continue searching
  1327→		}
  1328→
  1329→		_, fileErr := tree.File(metadataPath)
  1330→		if fileErr != nil {
  1331→			// File doesn't exist in this commit - we've gone past the creation point
  1332→			if foundCommit != nil {
  1333→				return errStopIteration
  1334→			}
  1335→			return nil
  1336→		}
  1337→
  1338→		// File exists - track it (oldest one with file is the creator)
  1339→		foundCommit = c
  1340→		author = Author{
  1341→			Name:  c.Author.Name,
  1342→			Email: c.Author.Email,
  1343→		}
  1344→		return nil
  1345→	})
  1346→
  1347→	// Ignore errStopIteration - it's just for early exit
  1348→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopIteration) {
  1349→		return Author{}, nil
  1350→	}
  1351→
  1352→	return author, nil
  1353→}

    30→// listCheckpoints returns all checkpoints from the metadata branch.

    59→
    60→	return result, nil
    61→}
    62→
    63→// getCheckpointsForSession returns all checkpoints for a session ID.
    64→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointsForSession(sessionID string) ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
    65→	all, err := s.listCheckpoints()
    66→	if err != nil {
    67→		return nil, err
    68→	}
    69→
    70→	var result []CheckpointInfo
    71→	for _, cp := range all {
    72→		if cp.SessionID == sessionID || strings.HasPrefix(cp.SessionID, sessionID) {
    73→			result = append(result, cp)
    74→		}
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	if len(result) == 0 {
    78→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no checkpoints for session: %s", sessionID)
    79→	}
    80→
    81→	return result, nil
    82→}
    83→
    84→// getCheckpointLog returns the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
    85→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ReadCommitted() for reading from entire/checkpoints/v1.
    86→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getCheckpointLog(checkpointID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, error) {
    87→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    88→	if err != nil {
    89→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(context.Background(), checkpointID)
    93→	if err != nil {
    94→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
    95→	}
    96→	if content == nil {
    97→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointID)
    98→	}
    99→	if len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   100→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   101→	}
   102→
   103→	return content.Transcript, nil
   104→}
   105→
   106→// CondenseSession condenses a session's shadow branch to permanent storage.
   107→// checkpointID is the 12-hex-char value from the Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
   108→// Metadata is stored at sharded path: <checkpoint_id[:2]>/<checkpoint_id[2:]>/
   109→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.WriteCommitted for the git operations.
   110→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   111→	// Get shadow branch
   112→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   113→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   114→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   115→	if err != nil {
   116→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("shadow branch not found: %w", err)
   117→	}
   118→
   119→	// Extract session data from the shadow branch (with live transcript fallback).
   120→	// Use tracked files from session state instead of collecting all files from tree.
   121→	// Pass agent type to handle different transcript formats (JSONL for Claude, JSON for Gemini).
   122→	// Pass live transcript path so condensation reads the current file rather than a
   123→	// potentially stale shadow branch copy (SaveChanges may have been skipped if the
   124→	// last turn had no code changes).
   125→	// Pass CheckpointTranscriptStart for accurate token calculation (line offset for Claude, message index for Gemini).
   126→	sessionData, err := s.extractSessionData(repo, ref.Hash(), state.SessionID, state.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   127→	if err != nil {
   128→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to extract session data: %w", err)
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Get checkpoint store
   132→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   133→	if err != nil {
   134→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Get author info
   138→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   139→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(repo, ref, sessionData, state)
   140→	// Get current branch name
   141→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   142→
   143→	// Generate summary if enabled
   144→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   145→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled() && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   146→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   147→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(logCtx, "summarize")
   148→
   149→		// Scope transcript to this checkpoint's portion.
   150→		// SliceFromLine only works for JSONL (Claude Code) transcripts where
   151→		// CheckpointTranscriptStart is a line offset. For Gemini JSON transcripts,
   152→		// CheckpointTranscriptStart is a message index and the transcript is a single
   153→		// JSON blob, so line-based slicing would produce malformed content.
   154→		// The summarizer (ParseFromBytes) only supports JSONL, so skip scoping for Gemini.
   155→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   156→		if state.AgentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   157→			scopedTranscript = sessionData.Transcript
   158→		} else {
   159→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   160→		}
   161→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   162→			var err error
   163→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, nil)
   164→			if err != nil {
   165→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   166→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   167→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   168→				// Continue without summary - non-blocking
   169→			} else {
   170→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   171→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   172→			}
   173→		}
   174→	}
   175→
   176→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   177→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(context.Background(), cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   178→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   179→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   180→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   181→		Branch:                      branchName,
   182→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   183→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   184→		Context:                     sessionData.Context,
   185→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   186→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   187→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   188→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   189→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   190→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   191→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   192→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   193→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   194→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   195→		Summary:                     summary,
   196→		SessionTranscriptPath:       homeRelativePath(state.TranscriptPath),
   197→	}); err != nil {
   198→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	return &CondenseResult{
   202→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   203→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   204→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   205→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   206→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   207→	}, nil
   208→}
   209→
   210→func calculateSessionAttributions(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   211→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   212→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   213→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   214→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
   215→	var attribution *cpkg.InitialAttribution
   216→	headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   217→	if headErr != nil {
   218→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   219→			slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   220→	} else {
   221→		headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   222→		if commitErr != nil {
   223→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   224→				slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   225→		} else {
   226→			headTree, treeErr := headCommit.Tree()
   227→			if treeErr != nil {
   228→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   229→					slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   230→			} else {
   231→				// Get shadow branch tree (checkpoint tree - what the agent wrote)
   232→				shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   233→				if shadowErr != nil {
   234→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   235→						slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   236→						slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   237→				} else {
   238→					shadowTree, shadowTreeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   239→					if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   240→						logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   241→							slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   242→					} else {
   243→						// Get base tree (state before session started)
   244→						var baseTree *object.Tree
   245→						attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   246→						if attrBase == "" {
   247→							attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   248→						}
   249→						if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   250→							if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   251→								baseTree = tree
   252→							} else {
   253→								logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   254→									slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   255→							}
   256→						} else {
   257→							logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   258→								slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   259→								slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   260→						}
   261→
   262→						// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   263→						var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   264→						for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   265→							totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   266→							totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   267→							logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   268→								slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   269→								slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   270→								slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   271→								slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   272→								slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   273→								slog.Int("index", i))
   274→						}
   275→
   276→						attribution = CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   277→							baseTree,
   278→							shadowTree,
   279→							headTree,
   280→							sessionData.FilesTouched,
   281→							state.PromptAttributions,
   282→						)
   283→
   284→						if attribution != nil {
   285→							logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   286→								slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   287→								slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   288→								slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   289→								slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   290→								slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   291→								slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   292→								slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   293→								slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   294→								slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   295→						}
   296→					}
   297→				}
   298→			}
   299→		}
   300→	}
   301→	return attribution
   302→}
   303→
   304→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   305→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   306→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   307→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   308→// This handles the case where SaveChanges was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   309→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   310→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   311→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType agent.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   312→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   313→	if err != nil {
   314→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   315→	}
   316→
   317→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   318→	if err != nil {
   319→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   320→	}
   321→
   322→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   323→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   324→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   325→
   326→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   327→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   328→	// (SaveChanges is only called when there are file modifications).
   329→	var fullTranscript string
   330→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   331→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   332→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   333→		}
   334→	}
   335→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   336→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   337→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   338→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   339→				fullTranscript = content
   340→			}
   341→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   342→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   343→				fullTranscript = content
   344→			}
   345→		}
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   349→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   350→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   351→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   352→		data.Prompts = extractUserPrompts(agentType, fullTranscript)
   353→		data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   357→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   358→
   359→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   360→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   361→		data.TokenUsage = calculateTokenUsage(agentType, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart)
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	return data, nil
   365→}
   366→
   367→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   368→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   369→// For Gemini CLI and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   370→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   371→func countTranscriptItems(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) int {
   372→	if content == "" {
   373→		return 0
   374→	}
   375→
   376→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   377→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   378→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   379→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   380→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   381→		}
   382→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   383→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   384→			return 0
   385→		}
   386→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   390→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   391→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   392→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   393→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   394→	}
   395→	return len(allLines)
   396→}
   397→
   398→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   399→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   400→func extractUserPrompts(agentType agent.AgentType, content string) []string {
   401→	if content == "" {
   402→		return nil
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   406→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   407→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   408→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   409→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   410→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   411→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   412→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   413→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   414→				}
   415→			}
   416→			return cleaned
   417→		}
   418→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   419→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   420→			return nil
   421→		}
   422→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   426→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   427→}
   428→
   429→// calculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from raw transcript data.
   430→// startOffset is the line number (Claude Code) or message index (Gemini CLI)
   431→// where the current checkpoint began, allowing calculation for only the portion
   432→// of the transcript since the last checkpoint.
   433→func calculateTokenUsage(agentType agent.AgentType, data []byte, startOffset int) *agent.TokenUsage {
   434→	if len(data) == 0 {
   435→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   436→	}
   437→
   438→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   439→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   440→		// Attempt to parse as Gemini JSON
   441→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript(data)
   442→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   443→			return geminicli.CalculateTokenUsage(data, startOffset)
   444→		}
   445→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return empty usage
   446→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   447→			return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   448→		}
   449→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   450→	}
   451→
   452→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   453→	lines, err := claudecode.ParseTranscript(data)
   454→	if err != nil || len(lines) == 0 {
   455→		return &agent.TokenUsage{}
   456→	}
   457→	// Slice transcript lines to only include checkpoint portion
   458→	if startOffset > 0 && startOffset < len(lines) {
   459→		lines = lines[startOffset:]
   460→	}
   461→	return claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(lines)
   462→}
   463→
   464→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   465→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   466→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   467→	var prompts []string
   468→	for _, line := range lines {
   469→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   470→		if line == "" {
   471→			continue
   472→		}
   473→
   474→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   475→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   476→			continue
   477→		}
   478→
   479→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   480→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   481→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   482→			continue
   483→		}
   484→
   485→		// Extract message content
   486→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   487→		if !ok {
   488→			continue
   489→		}
   490→
   491→		// Handle string content
   492→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   493→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   494→			if cleaned != "" {
   495→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   496→			}
   497→			continue
   498→		}
   499→
   500→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   501→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   502→			var texts []string
   503→			for _, item := range arr {
   504→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   505→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   506→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   507→							texts = append(texts, text)
   508→						}
   509→					}
   510→				}
   511→			}
   512→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   513→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   514→				if cleaned != "" {
   515→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   516→				}
   517→			}
   518→		}
   519→	}
   520→	return prompts
   521→}
   522→
   523→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   524→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   525→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   526→		return nil
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	var buf strings.Builder
   530→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   531→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   532→
   533→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   534→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   535→		displayPrompt := prompt
   536→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   537→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   538→		}
   539→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   540→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   541→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	return []byte(buf.String())
   545→}
   546→
   547→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   548→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   549→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(sessionID string) error {
   550→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "condense-by-id")
   551→
   552→	// Load session state
   553→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   554→	if err != nil {
   555→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   556→	}
   557→	if state == nil {
   558→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// Open repository
   562→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   563→	if err != nil {
   564→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   565→	}
   566→
   567→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   568→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   569→	if err != nil {
   570→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   574→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   575→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   576→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   577→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   578→
   579→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   580→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   581→		// Just clean up the state file.
   582→		logging.Info(ctx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   583→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   584→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   585→		)
   586→		if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
   587→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   588→		}
   589→		return nil
   590→	}
   591→
   592→	// Condense the session
   593→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   594→	if err != nil {
   595→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	logging.Info(ctx, "session condensed by ID",
   599→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   600→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   601→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   602→	)
   603→
   604→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   605→	state.StepCount = 0
   606→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   607→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   608→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   609→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   610→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   611→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   612→
   613→	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   614→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   615→	}
   616→
   617→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   618→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   619→		logging.Warn(ctx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   620→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   621→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   622→		)
   623→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	return nil
   627→}
   628→
   629→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   630→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(_ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   631→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   632→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()
   633→	if err != nil {
   634→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   635→	}
   636→
   637→	for _, state := range allStates {
   638→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   639→			continue
   640→		}
   641→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   642→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   643→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   644→			return nil
   645→		}
   646→	}
   647→
   648→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   649→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   650→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   651→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   652→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   653→			return nil
   654→		}
   655→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   656→	}
   657→	return nil
   658→}

   151→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.
   152→// Call this after deserializing a State from JSON.
   153→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad() {
   154→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   155→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   156→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   157→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   158→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   159→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {
   160→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.TranscriptLinesAtStart
   161→		}
   162→	}
   163→	// Clear deprecated fields so they aren't re-persisted.
   164→	// Note: this is a one-way migration. If the state is re-saved, older CLI versions
   165→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   166→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   167→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   168→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   169→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0
   170→
   171→	// Backfill AttributionBaseCommit for sessions created before this field existed.
   172→	// Without this, a mid-turn commit would migrate BaseCommit and the fallback in
   173→	// calculateSessionAttributions would use the migrated value, producing zero attribution.
   174→	if s.AttributionBaseCommit == "" && s.BaseCommit != "" {
   175→		s.AttributionBaseCommit = s.BaseCommit
   176→	}
   177→}
