   179→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
   180→//
   181→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   182→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   183→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   184→//
   185→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   186→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   187→type StateStore struct {
   188→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   189→	stateDir string
   190→}
   191→
   192→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   193→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   194→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   195→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   198→	}
   199→	return &StateStore{
   200→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, SessionStateDirName),
   201→	}, nil
   202→}
   203→
   204→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   205→// This is useful for testing.
   206→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   207→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   208→}
   209→
   210→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   211→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   212→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   213→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   214→
   215→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   216→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   217→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   218→	}
   219→
   220→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   221→
   222→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   223→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   224→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   225→	}
   226→	if err != nil {
   227→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	var state State
   231→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   232→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   233→	}
   234→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad()
   235→	return &state, nil
   236→}
   237→
   238→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   239→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   240→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   241→
   242→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   243→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   244→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   245→	}
   246→
   247→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   248→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→
   256→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   257→
   258→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   259→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   260→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   261→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   262→	}
   263→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   264→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   265→	}
   266→	return nil
   267→}
   268→
   269→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   270→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   271→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   272→
   273→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   274→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   275→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   276→	}
   277→
   278→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   279→
   280→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   281→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   282→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   283→		}
   284→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   285→	}
   286→	return nil
   287→}
   288→
   289→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   290→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   291→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   292→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   293→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   294→	}
   295→	return nil
   296→}
   297→
   298→// List returns all session states.
   299→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   300→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   301→
   302→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   303→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   304→		return nil, nil
   305→	}
   306→	if err != nil {
   307→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	var states []*State
   311→	for _, entry := range entries {
   312→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   313→			continue
   314→		}
   315→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   316→			continue // Skip temp files
   317→		}
   318→
   319→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   320→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   321→		if err != nil {
   322→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   323→		}
   324→		if state == nil {
   325→			continue
   326→		}
   327→
   328→		states = append(states, state)
   329→	}
   330→	return states, nil
   331→}
   332→
   333→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   334→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   335→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   336→}
   337→
   338→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   339→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   340→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   341→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {
   342→	ctx := context.Background()
   343→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   344→	cmd.Dir = "."
   345→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   346→	if err != nil {
   347→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   351→
   352→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   353→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   354→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   355→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   356→	}
   357→
   358→	return filepath.Clean(commonDir), nil
   359→}

  1078→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
  1079→		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
  1080→		TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1081→
  1082→		// Backfill AgentType if empty or set to the generic default "Agent"
  1083→		if !isSpecificAgentType(state.AgentType) && agentType != "" {
  1084→			state.AgentType = agentType
  1085→		}
  1086→
  1087→		// Backfill FirstPrompt if empty (for sessions created before the first_prompt field was added)
  1088→		if state.FirstPrompt == "" && userPrompt != "" {
  1089→			state.FirstPrompt = truncatePromptForStorage(userPrompt)
  1090→		}
  1091→
  1092→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
  1093→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
  1094→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
  1095→		}
  1096→
  1097→		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
  1098→		// These are set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
  1099→		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
  1100→		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
  1101→			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1102→		}
  1103→
  1104→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
  1105→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
  1106→		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
  1107→		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
  1108→		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
  1109→		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1110→		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1111→

  1113→		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
  1114→		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
  1115→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
  1116→		}
  1117→
  1118→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1119→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
  1120→		}
  1121→		return nil
  1122→	}
  1123→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
  1124→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
  1125→
  1126→	// Initialize new session
  1127→	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath, userPrompt)
  1128→	if err != nil {
  1129→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
  1130→	}
  1131→
  1132→	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
  1133→	TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1134→

  1136→	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
  1137→	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)

  1140→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)
  1141→	}

  1145→}

   105→// transitionCase is a single row in the transition table test.
   106→type transitionCase struct {
   107→	name        string
   108→	current     Phase
   109→	event       Event
   110→	ctx         TransitionContext
   111→	wantPhase   Phase
   112→	wantActions []Action
   113→}
   114→
   115→// runTransitionTests runs a slice of transition cases as parallel subtests.
   116→func runTransitionTests(t *testing.T, tests []transitionCase) {
   117→	t.Helper()
   118→	for _, tt := range tests {
   119→		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   120→			t.Parallel()
   121→			result := Transition(tt.current, tt.event, tt.ctx)
   122→			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantPhase, result.NewPhase, "unexpected NewPhase")
   123→			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantActions, result.Actions, "unexpected Actions")
   124→		})
   125→	}
   126→}

   401→			result := Transition(phase, event, TransitionContext{})
   402→			assert.NotEmpty(t, string(result.NewPhase),

   409→				phase, event, result.NewPhase)

   411→	}

    23→// TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation verifies that PostCommit on an
    24→// ACTIVE session transitions to ACTIVE_COMMITTED without condensing.
    25→// The shadow branch must be preserved because the session is still active.
    26→func TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_NoCondensation(t *testing.T) {
    27→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    28→	t.Chdir(dir)
    29→
    30→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    31→	require.NoError(t, err)
    32→
    33→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    34→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-active"
    35→
    36→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint so there is shadow branch content
    37→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
    38→
    39→	// Set phase to ACTIVE (simulating agent mid-turn)
    40→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
    41→	require.NoError(t, err)
    42→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
    43→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
    44→
    45→	// Create a commit WITH the Entire-Checkpoint trailer on the main branch
    46→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")
    47→
    48→	// Run PostCommit
    49→	err = s.PostCommit()
    50→	require.NoError(t, err)
    51→
    52→	// Verify phase transitioned to ACTIVE_COMMITTED
    53→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
    54→	require.NoError(t, err)
    55→	require.NotNil(t, state)
    56→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase,
    57→		"ACTIVE session should transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED on GitCommit")
    58→
    59→	// Verify shadow branch is NOT deleted (session is still active).
    60→	// After PostCommit, BaseCommit is updated to new HEAD, so use the current state.
    61→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
    62→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
    63→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
    64→	assert.NoError(t, err,
    65→		"shadow branch should be preserved when session is still active")
    66→}

    68→// TestPostCommit_IdleSession_Condenses verifies that PostCommit on an IDLE
    69→// session condenses session data and cleans up the shadow branch.
    70→func TestPostCommit_IdleSession_Condenses(t *testing.T) {
    71→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
    72→	t.Chdir(dir)
    73→
    74→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    75→	require.NoError(t, err)
    76→
    77→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    78→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-idle"
    79→
    80→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint so there is shadow branch content
    81→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
    82→
    83→	// Set phase to IDLE (agent turn finished, waiting for user)
    84→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
    85→	require.NoError(t, err)
    86→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
    87→	state.LastInteractionTime = nil
    88→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
    89→
    90→	// Record shadow branch name before PostCommit
    91→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
    92→
    93→	// Create a commit WITH the Entire-Checkpoint trailer
    94→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "b2c3d4e5f6a1")
    95→
    96→	// Run PostCommit
    97→	err = s.PostCommit()
    98→	require.NoError(t, err)
    99→
   100→	// Verify condensation happened: the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist
   101→	sessionsRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   102→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after condensation")
   103→	assert.NotNil(t, sessionsRef)
   104→
   105→	// Verify shadow branch IS deleted after condensation
   106→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   107→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   108→	assert.Error(t, err,
   109→		"shadow branch should be deleted after condensation for IDLE session")
   110→}

   112→// TestPostCommit_RebaseDuringActive_SkipsTransition verifies that PostCommit
   113→// is a no-op during rebase operations, leaving the session phase unchanged.
   114→func TestPostCommit_RebaseDuringActive_SkipsTransition(t *testing.T) {
   115→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   116→	t.Chdir(dir)
   117→
   118→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   119→	require.NoError(t, err)
   120→
   121→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   122→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-rebase"
   123→
   124→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   125→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   126→
   127→	// Set phase to ACTIVE
   128→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   129→	require.NoError(t, err)
   130→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   131→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   132→
   133→	// Capture shadow branch name BEFORE any state changes
   134→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   135→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   136→
   137→	// Simulate rebase in progress by creating .git/rebase-merge/ directory
   138→	gitDir := filepath.Join(dir, ".git")
   139→	rebaseMergeDir := filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")
   140→	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(rebaseMergeDir, 0o755))
   141→	defer os.RemoveAll(rebaseMergeDir)
   142→
   143→	// Create a commit WITH the checkpoint trailer
   144→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "c3d4e5f6a1b2")
   145→
   146→	// Run PostCommit
   147→	err = s.PostCommit()
   148→	require.NoError(t, err)
   149→
   150→	// Verify phase stayed ACTIVE (no transition during rebase)
   151→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   152→	require.NoError(t, err)
   153→	require.NotNil(t, state)
   154→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActive, state.Phase,
   155→		"session should stay ACTIVE during rebase (no transition)")
   156→
   157→	// Verify StepCount was NOT reset (no condensation happened)
   158→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   159→		"StepCount should be unchanged - no condensation during rebase")
   160→
   161→	// Verify NO condensation happened (entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should not exist)
   162→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   163→	require.Error(t, err,
   164→		"entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist - no condensation during rebase")
   165→
   166→	// Verify shadow branch still exists (not cleaned up during rebase)
   167→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   168→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   169→	assert.NoError(t, err,
   170→		"shadow branch should be preserved during rebase")
   171→}

   173→// TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists verifies that
   174→// the shadow branch is preserved when ANY session on it is still active,
   175→// even if another session on the same branch is IDLE and gets condensed.
   176→func TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists(t *testing.T) {
   177→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   178→	t.Chdir(dir)
   179→
   180→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   181→	require.NoError(t, err)
   182→
   183→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   184→	idleSessionID := "test-postcommit-idle-multi"
   185→	activeSessionID := "test-postcommit-active-multi"
   186→
   187→	// Initialize the idle session with a checkpoint
   188→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, idleSessionID)
   189→
   190→	// Get worktree path and base commit from the idle session
   191→	idleState, err := s.loadSessionState(idleSessionID)
   192→	require.NoError(t, err)
   193→	worktreePath := idleState.WorktreePath
   194→	baseCommit := idleState.BaseCommit
   195→	worktreeID := idleState.WorktreeID
   196→
   197→	// Set idle session to IDLE phase
   198→	idleState.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   199→	idleState.LastInteractionTime = nil
   200→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(idleState))
   201→
   202→	// Create a second session with the SAME base commit and worktree (concurrent session)
   203→	// Save the active session with ACTIVE phase and some checkpoints
   204→	now := time.Now()
   205→	activeState := &SessionState{
   206→		SessionID:           activeSessionID,
   207→		BaseCommit:          baseCommit,
   208→		WorktreePath:        worktreePath,
   209→		WorktreeID:          worktreeID,
   210→		StartedAt:           now,
   211→		Phase:               session.PhaseActive,
   212→		LastInteractionTime: &now,
   213→		StepCount:           1,
   214→	}
   215→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(activeState))
   216→
   217→	// Create a commit WITH the checkpoint trailer
   218→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "d4e5f6a1b2c3")
   219→
   220→	// Run PostCommit
   221→	err = s.PostCommit()
   222→	require.NoError(t, err)
   223→
   224→	// Verify the ACTIVE session's phase is now ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   225→	activeState, err = s.loadSessionState(activeSessionID)
   226→	require.NoError(t, err)
   227→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, activeState.Phase,
   228→		"ACTIVE session should transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED on GitCommit")
   229→
   230→	// Verify the IDLE session actually condensed (entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist)
   231→	idleState, err = s.loadSessionState(idleSessionID)
   232→	require.NoError(t, err)
   233→	sessionsRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   234→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after IDLE session condensation")
   235→	require.NotNil(t, sessionsRef)
   236→
   237→	// Verify IDLE session's StepCount was reset by condensation
   238→	assert.Equal(t, 0, idleState.StepCount,
   239→		"IDLE session StepCount should be reset after condensation")
   240→
   241→	// Verify shadow branch is NOT deleted because the ACTIVE session still needs it.
   242→	// After PostCommit, BaseCommit is updated to new HEAD via migration.
   243→	newShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(activeState.BaseCommit, activeState.WorktreeID)
   244→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(newShadowBranch)
   245→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   246→	assert.NoError(t, err,
   247→		"shadow branch should be preserved when an active session still exists on it")
   248→}

   250→// TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_PreservesShadowBranch verifies that when
   251→// condensation fails (corrupted shadow branch), BaseCommit is NOT updated.
   252→func TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_PreservesShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {
   253→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   254→	t.Chdir(dir)
   255→
   256→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   257→	require.NoError(t, err)
   258→
   259→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   260→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-condense-fail-idle"
   261→
   262→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   263→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   264→
   265→	// Set phase to IDLE
   266→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   267→	require.NoError(t, err)
   268→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   269→	state.LastInteractionTime = nil
   270→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   271→
   272→	// Record original BaseCommit and StepCount before corruption
   273→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
   274→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   275→
   276→	// Corrupt shadow branch by pointing it at ZeroHash
   277→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   278→	corruptRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch), plumbing.ZeroHash)
   279→	require.NoError(t, repo.Storer.SetReference(corruptRef))
   280→
   281→	// Create a commit with the checkpoint trailer
   282→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "e5f6a1b2c3d4")
   283→
   284→	// Run PostCommit
   285→	err = s.PostCommit()
   286→	require.NoError(t, err, "PostCommit should not return error even when condensation fails")
   287→
   288→	// Verify BaseCommit was NOT updated (condensation failed)
   289→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   290→	require.NoError(t, err)
   291→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.BaseCommit,
   292→		"BaseCommit should NOT be updated when condensation fails")
   293→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   294→		"StepCount should NOT be reset when condensation fails")
   295→
   296→	// Verify entire/checkpoints/v1 branch does NOT exist (condensation failed)
   297→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   298→	require.Error(t, err,
   299→		"entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist when condensation fails")
   300→
   301→	// Phase transition still applies even when condensation fails
   302→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase,
   303→		"phase should remain IDLE when condensation fails")
   304→}

   306→// TestPostCommit_IdleSession_NoNewContent_UpdatesBaseCommit verifies that when
   307→// an IDLE session has no new transcript content since last condensation,
   308→// PostCommit skips condensation but still updates BaseCommit.
   309→func TestPostCommit_IdleSession_NoNewContent_UpdatesBaseCommit(t *testing.T) {
   310→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   311→	t.Chdir(dir)
   312→
   313→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   314→	require.NoError(t, err)
   315→
   316→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   317→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-idle-no-content"
   318→
   319→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   320→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   321→
   322→	// Set phase to IDLE with CheckpointTranscriptStart matching transcript length (2 lines)
   323→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   324→	require.NoError(t, err)
   325→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   326→	state.LastInteractionTime = nil
   327→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 2 // Transcript has exactly 2 lines
   328→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   329→
   330→	// Record shadow branch name
   331→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   332→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   333→
   334→	// Create a commit with the checkpoint trailer
   335→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "f6a1b2c3d4e5")
   336→
   337→	// Get new HEAD hash for comparison
   338→	head, err := repo.Head()
   339→	require.NoError(t, err)
   340→	newHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
   341→
   342→	// Run PostCommit
   343→	err = s.PostCommit()
   344→	require.NoError(t, err)
   345→
   346→	// Verify BaseCommit was updated to new HEAD
   347→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   348→	require.NoError(t, err)
   349→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,
   350→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD when no new content")
   351→
   352→	// Shadow branch should still exist (not deleted, no condensation)
   353→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   354→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   355→	require.NoError(t, err,
   356→		"shadow branch should still exist when no condensation happened")
   357→
   358→	// entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist (no condensation)
   359→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   360→	require.Error(t, err,
   361→		"entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist when no condensation happened")
   362→
   363→	// StepCount should be unchanged
   364→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   365→		"StepCount should be unchanged when no condensation happened")
   366→}

   368→// TestPostCommit_EndedSession_FilesTouched_Condenses verifies that an ENDED
   369→// session with files touched and new content condenses on commit.
   370→func TestPostCommit_EndedSession_FilesTouched_Condenses(t *testing.T) {

   517→
   518→	// Get new HEAD hash
   519→	head, err := repo.Head()
   520→	require.NoError(t, err)

   522→
   523→	// Run PostCommit

   534→	require.NoError(t, err)
   535→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,
   536→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD on discard path")
   537→
   538→	// StepCount unchanged
   539→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   540→		"StepCount should be unchanged on discard path")
   541→
   542→	// Phase stays ENDED
   543→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseEnded, state.Phase,
   544→		"ENDED session should stay ENDED on discard path")
   545→}

   547→// TestPostCommit_ActiveCommitted_MigratesShadowBranch verifies that an
   548→// ACTIVE_COMMITTED session receiving another commit migrates the shadow branch
   549→// to the new HEAD and stays in ACTIVE_COMMITTED.
   550→func TestPostCommit_ActiveCommitted_MigratesShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {
   551→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   552→	t.Chdir(dir)
   553→
   554→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   555→	require.NoError(t, err)
   556→
   557→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   558→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-ac-migrate"
   559→
   560→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   561→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   562→
   563→	// Set phase to ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   564→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   565→	require.NoError(t, err)
   566→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActiveCommitted
   567→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   568→
   569→	// Record original shadow branch name and BaseCommit
   570→	originalShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   571→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   572→
   573→	// Create a commit with the checkpoint trailer
   574→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "d4e5f6a1b2c4")
   575→
   576→	// Run PostCommit
   577→	err = s.PostCommit()
   578→	require.NoError(t, err)
   579→
   580→	// Verify phase stays ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   581→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   582→	require.NoError(t, err)
   583→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase,
   584→		"ACTIVE_COMMITTED session should stay ACTIVE_COMMITTED on subsequent commit")
   585→
   586→	// Verify BaseCommit updated to new HEAD
   587→	head, err := repo.Head()
   588→	require.NoError(t, err)
   589→	assert.Equal(t, head.Hash().String(), state.BaseCommit,
   590→		"BaseCommit should be updated to new HEAD after migration")
   591→
   592→	// Verify new shadow branch exists at new HEAD hash
   593→	newShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   594→	newRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(newShadowBranch)
   595→	_, err = repo.Reference(newRefName, true)
   596→	require.NoError(t, err,
   597→		"new shadow branch should exist after migration")
   598→
   599→	// Verify original shadow branch no longer exists (was migrated/renamed)
   600→	oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(originalShadowBranch)
   601→	_, err = repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
   602→	require.Error(t, err,
   603→		"original shadow branch should no longer exist after migration")
   604→
   605→	// StepCount unchanged (no condensation)
   606→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   607→		"StepCount should be unchanged - no condensation for ACTIVE_COMMITTED")
   608→
   609→	// entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist (no condensation)
   610→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   611→	require.Error(t, err,
   612→		"entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist - no condensation for ACTIVE_COMMITTED")
   613→}

   615→// TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_EndedSession_PreservesShadowBranch verifies
   616→// that when condensation fails for an ENDED session with files touched,
   617→// BaseCommit is preserved (not updated).
   618→func TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_EndedSession_PreservesShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {
   619→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   620→	t.Chdir(dir)
   621→
   622→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   623→	require.NoError(t, err)
   624→
   625→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   626→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-condense-fail-ended"
   627→
   628→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   629→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   630→
   631→	// Set phase to ENDED with files touched
   632→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   633→	require.NoError(t, err)
   634→	now := time.Now()
   635→	state.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
   636→	state.EndedAt = &now
   637→	state.FilesTouched = []string{"test.txt"}
   638→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   639→
   640→	// Record original BaseCommit and StepCount
   641→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit
   642→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   643→
   644→	// Corrupt shadow branch by pointing it at ZeroHash
   645→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   646→	corruptRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch), plumbing.ZeroHash)
   647→	require.NoError(t, repo.Storer.SetReference(corruptRef))
   648→
   649→	// Create a commit with the checkpoint trailer
   650→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "e5f6a1b2c3d5")
   651→
   652→	// Run PostCommit
   653→	err = s.PostCommit()
   654→	require.NoError(t, err, "PostCommit should not return error even when condensation fails")
   655→
   656→	// Verify BaseCommit was NOT updated (condensation failed)
   657→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   658→	require.NoError(t, err)
   659→	assert.Equal(t, originalBaseCommit, state.BaseCommit,
   660→		"BaseCommit should NOT be updated when condensation fails for ENDED session")
   661→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   662→		"StepCount should NOT be reset when condensation fails for ENDED session")
   663→
   664→	// Verify entire/checkpoints/v1 branch does NOT exist (condensation failed)
   665→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   666→	require.Error(t, err,
   667→		"entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should NOT exist when condensation fails")
   668→
   669→	// Phase stays ENDED
   670→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseEnded, state.Phase,
   671→		"ENDED session should stay ENDED when condensation fails")
   672→}

   754→		"condensation should use PendingCheckpointID, not generate a new one")

   757→// TestTurnEnd_ConcurrentSession_PreservesShadowBranch verifies that
   758→// HandleTurnEnd does NOT delete the shadow branch when another active
   759→// session shares it.
   760→func TestTurnEnd_ConcurrentSession_PreservesShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {
   761→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   762→	t.Chdir(dir)
   763→
   764→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   765→	require.NoError(t, err)
   766→
   767→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   768→	sessionID1 := "test-turnend-concurrent-1"
   769→	sessionID2 := "test-turnend-concurrent-2"
   770→
   771→	// Initialize first session and save a checkpoint
   772→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID1)
   773→
   774→	// Get worktree info from first session
   775→	state1, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID1)
   776→	require.NoError(t, err)
   777→	worktreePath := state1.WorktreePath
   778→	baseCommit := state1.BaseCommit
   779→	worktreeID := state1.WorktreeID
   780→
   781→	// Transition first session through PostCommit to ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   782→	state1.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   783→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state1))
   784→
   785→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "e5f6a1b2c3d4")
   786→
   787→	err = s.PostCommit()
   788→	require.NoError(t, err)
   789→
   790→	state1, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID1)
   791→	require.NoError(t, err)
   792→	require.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state1.Phase)
   793→
   794→	// Create a second session with the SAME base commit and worktree (concurrent)
   795→	now := time.Now()
   796→	state2 := &SessionState{
   797→		SessionID:           sessionID2,
   798→		BaseCommit:          state1.BaseCommit, // Same base commit (post-migration)
   799→		WorktreePath:        worktreePath,
   800→		WorktreeID:          worktreeID,
   801→		StartedAt:           now,
   802→		Phase:               session.PhaseActive,
   803→		LastInteractionTime: &now,
   804→		StepCount:           1,
   805→	}
   806→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state2))
   807→
   808→	// Record shadow branch name (shared by both sessions)
   809→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state1.BaseCommit, state1.WorktreeID)
   810→
   811→	// First session ends its turn — should NOT delete shadow branch
   812→	result := session.Transition(state1.Phase, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
   813→	remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state1, result)
   814→
   815→	err = s.HandleTurnEnd(state1, remaining)
   816→	require.NoError(t, err)
   817→
   818→	// Shadow branch at the pre-condensation BaseCommit should be preserved
   819→	// because session2 is still active on it.
   820→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   821→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   822→	require.NoError(t, err,
   823→		"shadow branch should be preserved when another active session shares it")
   824→
   825→	// Condensation still succeeded for session1
   826→	assert.Equal(t, 0, state1.StepCount,
   827→		"StepCount should be reset after condensation")
   828→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseIdle, state1.Phase,
   829→		"first session should be IDLE after turn end")
   830→
   831→	// Second session is still active and unaffected
   832→	state2, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID2)
   833→	require.NoError(t, err)
   834→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActive, state2.Phase,
   835→		"second session should still be ACTIVE")
   836→	_ = baseCommit // used for documentation
   837→}

   839→// TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensesSession verifies that HandleTurnEnd
   840→// with ActionCondense (from ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE) condenses the session
   841→// to entire/checkpoints/v1 and cleans up the shadow branch.
   842→func TestTurnEnd_ActiveCommitted_CondensesSession(t *testing.T) {
   843→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   844→	t.Chdir(dir)
   845→
   846→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   847→	require.NoError(t, err)
   848→
   849→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   850→	sessionID := "test-turnend-condenses"
   851→
   852→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint so there is shadow branch content
   853→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   854→
   855→	// Simulate PostCommit: create a commit with trailer and transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   856→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   857→	require.NoError(t, err)
   858→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   859→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   860→
   861→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")
   862→
   863→	// Run PostCommit so phase transitions to ACTIVE_COMMITTED and PendingCheckpointID is set
   864→	err = s.PostCommit()
   865→	require.NoError(t, err)
   866→
   867→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   868→	require.NoError(t, err)
   869→	require.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase)
   870→
   871→	// Now simulate the TurnEnd transition that the handler dispatches
   872→	result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
   873→	remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   874→
   875→	// Verify the state machine emits ActionCondense
   876→	require.Contains(t, remaining, session.ActionCondense,
   877→		"ACTIVE_COMMITTED + TurnEnd should emit ActionCondense")
   878→
   879→	// Record shadow branch name BEFORE HandleTurnEnd (BaseCommit may change)
   880→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   881→
   882→	// Call HandleTurnEnd with the remaining actions
   883→	err = s.HandleTurnEnd(state, remaining)
   884→	require.NoError(t, err)
   885→
   886→	// Verify condensation happened: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist
   887→	sessionsRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   888→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after turn-end condensation")
   889→	assert.NotNil(t, sessionsRef)
   890→
   891→	// Verify shadow branch IS deleted after condensation
   892→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   893→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   894→	require.Error(t, err,
   895→		"shadow branch should be deleted after turn-end condensation")
   896→
   897→	// Verify StepCount was reset by condensation
   898→	assert.Equal(t, 0, state.StepCount,
   899→		"StepCount should be reset after condensation")
   900→
   901→	// Verify phase is IDLE (set by ApplyCommonActions above)
   902→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase,
   903→		"phase should be IDLE after TurnEnd")
   904→}

  1016→// TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase verifies that
  1017→// deferred condensation (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE) uses AttributionBaseCommit
  1018→// instead of BaseCommit for attribution, so the diff is non-zero.
  1019→//
  1020→// Scenario: agent modifies a file, user commits mid-turn, then turn ends.
  1021→// Without the fix, BaseCommit is updated to the new HEAD by PostCommit migration,
  1022→// so baseTree == headTree and attribution shows zero changes.
  1023→// With the fix, AttributionBaseCommit preserves the original base commit.
  1024→func TestTurnEnd_DeferredCondensation_AttributionUsesOriginalBase(t *testing.T) {
  1025→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
  1026→	t.Chdir(dir)
  1027→
  1028→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
  1029→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1030→
  1031→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
  1032→	sessionID := "test-deferred-attribution"
  1033→
  1034→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint that includes a modified file.
  1035→	// The "agent" modifies test.txt before saving the checkpoint.
  1036→	setupSessionWithFileChange(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)

  1038→	// Record the original base commit (commit A)
  1039→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)

  1043→	// Verify AttributionBaseCommit is set at session init

  1046→
  1047→	// Set phase to ACTIVE (simulating agent mid-turn)
  1048→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
  1049→	state.FilesTouched = []string{"test.txt"}
  1050→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
  1051→
  1052→	// User commits (creates commit B). This triggers PostCommit which:
  1053→	// - Transitions ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED (defers condensation)
  1054→	// - Migrates shadow branch to new HEAD
  1055→	// - Updates BaseCommit to new HEAD
  1056→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "a1b2c3d4e5f6")

  1058→	err = s.PostCommit()

  1061→	// Reload state and verify the key invariant:

  1066→
  1067→	head, err := repo.Head()

  1071→	assert.Equal(t, newHeadHash, state.BaseCommit,

  1083→	err = s.HandleTurnEnd(state, remaining)

  1086→	// After condensation, verify AttributionBaseCommit is updated to match BaseCommit
  1087→	assert.Equal(t, state.BaseCommit, state.AttributionBaseCommit,
  1088→		"AttributionBaseCommit should be updated after successful condensation")

  1090→	// Verify condensation actually happened
  1091→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
  1092→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/sessions branch should exist after deferred condensation")

  1094→	// Read back the committed metadata and verify attribution is non-zero.

  1096→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)

  1098→	content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), cpID, 0)

  1313→// commitWithCheckpointTrailer creates a commit on the current branch with the
  1314→// Entire-Checkpoint trailer in the commit message. This simulates what happens
  1315→// after PrepareCommitMsg adds the trailer and the user completes the commit.
  1316→func commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t *testing.T, repo *git.Repository, dir, checkpointIDStr string) {

  1327→	require.NoError(t, err)
  1328→
  1329→	_, err = wt.Add("test.txt")

  1337→			When:  time.Now(),
  1338→		},
  1339→	})
  1340→	require.NoError(t, err, "commit with checkpoint trailer should succeed")
  1341→}

   202→
   203→	// Create blob for transcript

    24→// Bug: ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset returns absolute paths (e.g., /tmp/repo/src/main.go)
    25→// but getStagedFiles returns repo-relative paths (e.g., src/main.go). The exact-string
    26→// comparison in hasOverlappingFiles never matches, causing "no content to link".
    27→func TestSessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript_NormalizesAbsolutePaths(t *testing.T) {
    28→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)

    30→
    31→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
    32→	require.NoError(t, err)

    34→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
    35→
    36→	// Create a file that we'll stage

    38→	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(srcDir, 0o755))

    41→
    42→	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
    43→	require.NoError(t, err)
    44→	_, err = wt.Add("src/main.go")
    45→	require.NoError(t, err)
    46→
    47→	// Get the resolved worktree path first — on macOS, t.TempDir() returns /var/...
    48→	// but git resolves symlinks to /private/var/... . Claude Code uses the resolved
    49→	// path in its transcript, so we must too.
    50→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
    51→	require.NoError(t, err)
    52→	worktreeID, err := paths.GetWorktreeID(worktreePath)
    53→	require.NoError(t, err)
    54→
    55→	// Create a transcript file that references the file by absolute path
    56→	// (this is what Claude Code does — tool_use Write has absolute file_path)
    57→	absFilePath := filepath.Join(worktreePath, "src", "main.go")
    58→	transcriptContent := `{"type":"human","message":{"content":"write a main.go file"}}
    59→{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"` + absFilePath + `","content":"package main\n"}}]}}
    60→`
    61→	transcriptPath := filepath.Join(dir, "transcript.jsonl")
    62→	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(transcriptPath, []byte(transcriptContent), 0o644))
    63→
    64→	// Create session state: no shadow branch (it was deleted after last condensation),
    65→	// transcript path points to the file, agent type is Claude Code
    66→	now := time.Now()
    67→
    68→	head, err := repo.Head()
    69→	require.NoError(t, err)
    70→
    71→	state := &SessionState{
    72→		SessionID:                 "test-abs-path-normalize",
    73→		BaseCommit:                head.Hash().String(),
    74→		WorktreePath:              worktreePath,
    75→		WorktreeID:                worktreeID,

    94→// TestPostCommit_NoTrailer_UpdatesBaseCommit verifies that when a commit has no
    95→// Entire-Checkpoint trailer, PostCommit still updates BaseCommit for active sessions.
    96→//
    97→// Bug: PostCommit early-returns when no trailer is found (line ~530-536). EventGitCommit
    98→// never fires, BaseCommit never updates. All subsequent commits fail the
    99→// BaseCommit == currentHeadHash filter in PrepareCommitMsg.
   100→func TestPostCommit_NoTrailer_UpdatesBaseCommit(t *testing.T) {
   101→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)

   113→	// Set phase to ACTIVE

   115→	require.NoError(t, err)
   116→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   117→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   118→
   119→	originalBaseCommit := state.BaseCommit

   121→	// Create a commit WITHOUT a trailer (user removed it, or mid-turn commit
   122→	// where PrepareCommitMsg couldn't add one due to Bug 1)
   123→	testFile := filepath.Join(dir, "test.txt")

   144→	// Run PostCommit

   197→	// Call SaveChanges — this should NOT clear PendingCheckpointID

    19→// stalenessThreshold is the duration after which an active session is considered stuck.
    20→const stalenessThreshold = 1 * time.Hour
    21→
    22→func newDoctorCmd() *cobra.Command {
    23→	var forceFlag bool
    24→
    25→	cmd := &cobra.Command{
    26→		Use:   "doctor",
    27→		Short: "Fix stuck sessions",
    28→		Long: `Scan for stuck or problematic sessions and offer to fix them.
    29→
    30→A session is considered stuck if:
    31→  - It is in ACTIVE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED phase with no interaction for over 1 hour
    32→  - It is in ENDED phase with uncondensed checkpoint data on a shadow branch
    33→
    34→For each stuck session, you can choose to:
    35→  - Condense: Save session data to permanent storage (entire/checkpoints/v1 branch)
    36→  - Discard: Remove the session state and shadow branch data
    37→  - Skip: Leave the session as-is
    38→
    39→Use --force to condense all fixable sessions without prompting.  Sessions that can't
    40→be condensed will be discarded.`,
    41→		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
    42→			return runSessionsFix(cmd, forceFlag)
    43→		},
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&forceFlag, "force", "f", false, "Fix all stuck sessions without prompting (condense if possible, otherwise discard)")
    47→
    48→	return cmd
    49→}
    50→
    51→// stuckSession holds a session state along with diagnostic info.
    52→type stuckSession struct {
    53→	State             *strategy.SessionState
    54→	Reason            string
    55→	ShadowBranch      string
    56→	HasShadowBranch   bool
    57→	CheckpointCount   int
    58→	FilesTouchedCount int
    59→}
    60→
    61→func runSessionsFix(cmd *cobra.Command, force bool) error {
    62→	// Load all session states
    63→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
    64→	if err != nil {
    65→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	if len(states) == 0 {
    69→		fmt.Fprintln(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "No stuck sessions found.")
    70→		return nil
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	// Open repository to check shadow branches (uses worktree-aware helper)
    74→	repo, err := openRepository()
    75→	if err != nil {
    76→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	// Identify stuck sessions
    80→	now := time.Now()
    81→	var stuck []stuckSession
    82→
    83→	for _, state := range states {
    84→		ss := classifySession(state, repo, now)
    85→		if ss != nil {
    86→			stuck = append(stuck, *ss)
    87→		}
    88→	}
    89→
    90→	if len(stuck) == 0 {
    91→		fmt.Fprintln(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "No stuck sessions found.")
    92→		return nil
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	// Get the current strategy for condense operations
    96→	strat := GetStrategy()
    97→	condenser, canCondense := strat.(strategy.SessionCondenser)
    98→
    99→	fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "Found %d stuck session(s):\n\n", len(stuck))
   100→
   101→	for _, ss := range stuck {
   102→		displayStuckSession(cmd, ss)
   103→
   104→		if force {
   105→			if canCondense && ss.HasShadowBranch && ss.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   106→				if err := condenser.CondenseSessionByID(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   107→					fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: failed to condense session %s: %v\n", ss.State.SessionID, err)
   108→				} else {
   109→					fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "  -> Condensed session %s\n\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   110→				}
   111→			} else {
   112→				// Discard if we can't condense
   113→				if err := discardSession(ss, repo, cmd.ErrOrStderr()); err != nil {
   114→					fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: failed to discard session %s: %v\n", ss.State.SessionID, err)
   115→				} else {
   116→					fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "  -> Discarded session %s\n\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   117→				}
   118→			}
   119→			continue
   120→		}
   121→
   122→		// Interactive: prompt for action
   123→		action, err := promptSessionAction(ss, canCondense)
   124→		if err != nil {
   125→			if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   126→				return nil
   127→			}
   128→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get action: %w", err)
   129→		}
   130→
   131→		switch action {
   132→		case "condense":
   133→			if !canCondense {
   134→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Strategy %s does not support condensation\n", strat.Name())
   135→				continue
   136→			}
   137→			if err := condenser.CondenseSessionByID(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   138→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: failed to condense session %s: %v\n", ss.State.SessionID, err)
   139→			} else {
   140→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "  -> Condensed session %s\n\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   141→			}
   142→		case "discard":
   143→			if err := discardSession(ss, repo, cmd.ErrOrStderr()); err != nil {
   144→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: failed to discard session %s: %v\n", ss.State.SessionID, err)
   145→			} else {
   146→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "  -> Discarded session %s\n\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   147→			}
   148→		case "skip":
   149→			fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "  -> Skipped\n\n")
   150→		}
   151→	}
   152→
   153→	return nil
   154→}
   155→
   156→// classifySession determines if a session is stuck and returns diagnostic info.
   157→// Returns nil if the session is healthy.
   158→func classifySession(state *strategy.SessionState, repo *git.Repository, now time.Time) *stuckSession {
   159→	// Determine shadow branch info
   160→	shadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   161→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   162→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   163→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   164→
   165→	switch {
   166→	case state.Phase.IsActive():
   167→		// Active sessions are stuck if no interaction for over the staleness threshold
   168→		isStale := state.LastInteractionTime == nil || now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime) > stalenessThreshold
   169→		if !isStale {
   170→			return nil
   171→		}
   172→
   173→		var reason string
   174→		if state.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   175→			reason = fmt.Sprintf("active, last interaction %s ago", now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime).Truncate(time.Minute))
   176→		} else {
   177→			reason = "active, no recorded interaction time"
   178→		}
   179→
   180→		return &stuckSession{
   181→			State:             state,
   182→			Reason:            reason,
   183→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   184→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   185→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   186→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   187→		}
   188→
   189→	case state.Phase == session.PhaseEnded:
   190→		// Ended sessions are stuck if they have uncondensed data
   191→		if state.StepCount <= 0 || !hasShadowBranch {
   192→			return nil
   193→		}
   194→
   195→		return &stuckSession{
   196→			State:             state,
   197→			Reason:            "ended with uncondensed checkpoint data",
   198→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   199→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   200→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   201→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   202→		}
   203→
   204→	default:
   205→		return nil
   206→	}
   207→}
   208→
   209→// displayStuckSession prints diagnostic info for a stuck session.
   210→func displayStuckSession(cmd *cobra.Command, ss stuckSession) {
   211→	w := cmd.OutOrStdout()
   212→
   213→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Session: %s\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   214→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Phase:   %s\n", ss.State.Phase)
   215→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Reason:  %s\n", ss.Reason)
   216→
   217→	if ss.State.AgentType != "" {
   218→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Agent:   %s\n", ss.State.AgentType)
   219→	}
   220→
   221→	if ss.State.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   222→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Last interaction: %s\n", ss.State.LastInteractionTime.Format(time.RFC3339))
   223→	}
   224→
   225→	shadowStatus := "not found"
   226→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   227→		shadowStatus = fmt.Sprintf("exists (%s)", ss.ShadowBranch)
   228→	}
   229→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Shadow branch: %s\n", shadowStatus)
   230→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Checkpoints: %d, Files touched: %d\n", ss.CheckpointCount, ss.FilesTouchedCount)
   231→}
   232→
   233→// promptSessionAction asks the user what to do with a stuck session.
   234→func promptSessionAction(ss stuckSession, canCondense bool) (string, error) {
   235→	var action string
   236→
   237→	options := make([]huh.Option[string], 0, 3)
   238→	if canCondense && ss.HasShadowBranch && ss.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   239→		options = append(options, huh.NewOption("Condense (save to permanent storage)", "condense"))
   240→	}
   241→	options = append(options,
   242→		huh.NewOption("Discard (remove session data)", "discard"),
   243→		huh.NewOption("Skip (leave as-is)", "skip"),
   244→	)
   245→
   246→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   247→		huh.NewGroup(
   248→			huh.NewSelect[string]().
   249→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Fix session %s?", ss.State.SessionID)).
   250→				Options(options...).
   251→				Value(&action),
   252→		),
   253→	)
   254→
   255→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   256→		return "", fmt.Errorf("session fix prompt failed: %w", err)
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	return action, nil
   260→}
   261→
   262→// discardSession removes session state and cleans up the shadow branch.
   263→func discardSession(ss stuckSession, _ *git.Repository, errW io.Writer) error {
   264→	// Clear session state file
   265→	if err := strategy.ClearSessionState(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   266→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   267→	}
   268→
   269→	// Delete shadow branch if it exists and no other sessions need it
   270→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   271→		if shouldDelete, err := canDeleteShadowBranch(ss.ShadowBranch, ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   272→			fmt.Fprintf(errW, "Warning: could not check other sessions for shadow branch: %v\n", err)
   273→		} else if shouldDelete {
   274→			if err := strategy.DeleteBranchCLI(ss.ShadowBranch); err != nil {
   275→				// Branch already gone is not an error — keeps discard idempotent
   276→				if !errors.Is(err, strategy.ErrBranchNotFound) {
   277→					return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete shadow branch: %w", err)
   278→				}
   279→			}
   280→		}
   281→	}
   282→
   283→	return nil
   284→}
   285→
   286→// canDeleteShadowBranch checks if a shadow branch can be safely deleted.
   287→// Returns true if no other sessions (besides excludeSessionID) need this branch.
   288→func canDeleteShadowBranch(shadowBranch, excludeSessionID string) (bool, error) {
   289→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
   290→	if err != nil {
   291→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   292→	}
   293→
   294→	for _, state := range states {
   295→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   296→			continue
   297→		}
   298→		otherShadow := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   299→		if otherShadow == shadowBranch && state.StepCount > 0 {
   300→			return false, nil
   301→		}
   302→	}
   303→
   304→	return true, nil
   305→}
   306→

    14→func newResetCmd() *cobra.Command {

    22→
    23→This allows starting fresh without existing checkpoints on your current commit.
    24→
    25→Only works with the manual-commit strategy. For auto-commit strategy,
    26→use Git directly: git reset --hard <commit>
    27→
    28→The command will:
    29→  - Find all sessions where base_commit matches the current HEAD
    30→  - Delete each session state file (.git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json)
    31→  - Delete the shadow branch (entire/<commit-hash>-<worktree-hash>)
    32→
    33→Use --session <id> to reset a single session instead of all sessions.

    37→  2. Delete those session files (e.g., 2026-02-02-xyz123.json, 2026-02-02-abc456.json)
    38→  3. Delete the shadow branch entire/abc1234-fd5432
    39→
    40→Without --force, prompts for confirmation before deleting.`,

   117→// runResetSession handles the --session flag: reset a single session.
   118→func runResetSession(cmd *cobra.Command, resetter strategy.SessionResetter, sessionID string, force bool) error {
   119→	// Verify the session exists
   120→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   121→	if err != nil {
   122→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session: %w", err)
   123→	}
   124→	if state == nil {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	if !force {
   129→		var confirmed bool
   130→
   131→		title := fmt.Sprintf("Reset session %s?", sessionID)
   132→		description := fmt.Sprintf("Phase: %s, Checkpoints: %d", state.Phase, state.StepCount)
   133→
   134→		form := NewAccessibleForm(
   135→			huh.NewGroup(
   136→				huh.NewConfirm().
   137→					Title(title).
   138→					Description(description).
   139→					Value(&confirmed),
   140→			),
   141→		)
   142→
   143→		if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   144→			if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) {
   145→				return nil
   146→			}
   147→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get confirmation: %w", err)
   148→		}
   149→
   150→		if !confirmed {
   151→			return nil
   152→		}
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	if err := resetter.ResetSession(sessionID); err != nil {
   156→		return fmt.Errorf("reset session failed: %w", err)
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "Session %s has been reset. File changes remain in the working directory.\n", sessionID)
   160→	return nil
   161→}
   162→
   163→// activeSessionsOnCurrentHead returns sessions on the current HEAD
   164→// that are in an active phase (ACTIVE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED).
   165→func activeSessionsOnCurrentHead() ([]*session.State, error) {
   166→	repo, err := openRepository()
   167→	if err != nil {
   168→		return nil, err
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	head, err := repo.Head()
   172→	if err != nil {
   173→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   174→	}
   175→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   176→
   177→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
   178→	if err != nil {
   179→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   180→	}
   181→
   182→	var active []*session.State
   183→	for _, state := range states {
   184→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   185→			continue
   186→		}
   187→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   188→			active = append(active, state)
   189→		}
   190→	}
   191→
   192→	return active, nil
   193→}

   240→// handleSessionStartCommon is the shared implementation for session start hooks.
   241→// Used by both Claude Code and Gemini CLI handlers.
   242→func handleSessionStartCommon() error {
   243→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   244→	if err != nil {
   245→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   246→	}
   247→
   248→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookSessionStart, os.Stdin)
   249→	if err != nil {
   250→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   254→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-start",
   255→		slog.String("hook", "session-start"),
   256→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   257→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   258→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   259→	)
   260→
   261→	if input.SessionID == "" {
   262→		return errors.New("no session_id in input")
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	// Build informational message
   266→	message := "\n\nPowered by Entire:\n  This conversation will be linked to your next commit."
   267→
   268→	// Check for concurrent sessions and append count if any
   269→	strat := GetStrategy()
   270→	if concurrentChecker, ok := strat.(strategy.ConcurrentSessionChecker); ok {
   271→		if count, err := concurrentChecker.CountOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(input.SessionID); err == nil && count > 0 {
   272→			message += fmt.Sprintf("\n  %d other active conversation(s) in this workspace will also be included.\n  Use 'entire status' for more information.", count)
   273→		}
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	// Output informational message using agent-specific format
   277→	if err := outputHookResponse(message); err != nil {
   278→		return err
   279→	}
   280→
   281→	// Fire EventSessionStart for the current session (if state exists).
   282→	// This handles ENDED → IDLE (re-entering a session).
   283→	// TODO(ENT-221): dispatch ActionWarnStaleSession for ACTIVE/ACTIVE_COMMITTED sessions.
   284→	if state, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(input.SessionID); loadErr != nil {
   285→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state on start: %v\n", loadErr)
   286→	} else if state != nil {
   287→		strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStart, session.TransitionContext{})
   288→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); saveErr != nil {
   289→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state on start: %v\n", saveErr)
   290→		}
   291→	}
   292→
   293→	return nil
   294→}

   296→// hookResponse represents a JSON response.
   297→// Used to control whether Agent continues processing the prompt.
   298→type hookResponse struct {
   299→	SystemMessage string `json:"systemMessage,omitempty"`
   300→}
   301→
   302→// outputHookResponse outputs a JSON response to stdout
   303→func outputHookResponse(reason string) error {
   304→	resp := hookResponse{
   305→		SystemMessage: reason,
   306→	}
   307→	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(resp); err != nil {
   308→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to encode hook response: %w", err)
   309→	}
   310→	return nil
   311→}

   340→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   341→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   342→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   343→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   344→		AgentType:                agentType,
   345→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   346→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   347→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   351→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   352→	}
   353→
   354→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   355→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   356→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   357→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   358→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   359→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   360→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   361→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   362→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   363→		if loadErr != nil {
   364→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   365→		}
   366→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   367→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   368→		if sessionState == nil {
   369→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   370→				SessionID: sessionID,
   371→			}
   372→		}
   373→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   374→		sessionState.StepCount++
   375→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   376→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   377→		} else {
   378→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   379→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   380→		}
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   384→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   385→	// For ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE, HandleTurnEnd dispatches ActionCondense.
   386→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   387→
   388→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   389→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   390→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   391→	}
   392→
   393→	return nil
   394→}
   395→
   396→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   397→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   398→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   399→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   400→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   401→	if err != nil {
   402→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Get agent for logging context
   406→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   407→	if err != nil {
   408→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   409→	}
   410→
   411→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   412→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   413→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   414→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   415→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   416→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   417→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   418→	)
   419→
   420→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   421→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   422→	if !found {
   423→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   424→		return nil
   425→	}
   426→
   427→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   428→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   429→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   430→		return nil
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   434→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   435→	if err != nil {
   436→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   437→		return nil
   438→	}
   439→
   440→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   441→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   442→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   443→		return nil
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	// Get git author
   447→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   448→	if err != nil {
   449→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   450→		return nil
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	// Get the active strategy
   454→	strat := GetStrategy()
   455→
   456→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   457→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   458→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   459→		return nil
   460→	}
   461→
   462→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   463→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   464→	if sessionID == "" {
   465→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   466→	}
   467→
   468→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   469→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   470→
   471→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   472→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   473→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   474→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   475→	if todoContent == "" {
   476→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   477→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   478→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   479→		if todoCount > 0 {
   480→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   481→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   482→		}
   483→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   484→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   488→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   489→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   490→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   491→	}
   492→
   493→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   494→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   495→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   496→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   497→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   498→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   499→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   500→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   501→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   502→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   503→		IsIncremental:       true,
   504→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   505→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   506→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   507→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   508→		AgentType:           agentType,
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   512→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   513→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   514→		return nil
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   518→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   519→	return nil
   520→}
