   522→// handleClaudeCodePreTask handles the PreToolUse[Task] hook
   523→func handleClaudeCodePreTask() error {
   524→	input, err := parseTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   525→	if err != nil {
   526→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PreToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	// Get agent for logging context
   530→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   531→	if err != nil {
   532→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   536→	logging.Info(logCtx, "pre-task",
   537→		slog.String("hook", "pre-task"),
   538→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   539→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   540→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   541→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   542→	)
   543→
   544→	// Log context to stdout
   545→	logPreTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input)
   546→
   547→	// Capture pre-task state locally (for computing new files when task completes).
   548→	// We don't create a shadow branch commit here. Commits are created during
   549→	// task completion (handleClaudeCodePostTask/handleClaudeCodePostTodo) only if the task resulted
   550→	// in file changes.
   551→	if err := CapturePreTaskState(input.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   552→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to capture pre-task state: %w", err)
   553→	}
   554→
   555→	return nil
   556→}
   557→
   558→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   559→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   560→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   561→	if err != nil {
   562→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   566→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   567→
   568→	// Get agent for logging context
   569→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   570→	if err != nil {
   571→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   572→	}
   573→
   574→	// Log parsed input context
   575→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   576→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   577→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   578→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   579→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   580→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   581→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   582→	)
   583→
   584→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   585→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   586→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   587→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   588→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   589→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   590→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   591→		}
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	// Log context to stdout
   595→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   596→
   597→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   598→	var modifiedFiles []string
   599→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   600→		// Use subagent transcript if available
   601→		transcript, err := parseTranscript(subagentTranscriptPath)
   602→		if err != nil {
   603→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse subagent transcript: %v\n", err)
   604→		} else {
   605→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   606→		}
   607→	} else {
   608→		// Fall back to main transcript
   609→		transcript, err := parseTranscript(input.TranscriptPath)
   610→		if err != nil {
   611→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse transcript: %v\n", err)
   612→		} else {
   613→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   614→		}
   615→	}
   616→
   617→	// Load pre-task state and compute new files
   618→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID)
   619→	if err != nil {
   620→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-task state: %v\n", err)
   621→	}
   622→
   623→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   624→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   625→	if err != nil {
   626→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   627→	}
   628→
   629→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   630→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   631→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   632→	if err != nil {
   633→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   634→	}
   635→
   636→	// Filter and normalize paths
   637→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   638→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   639→	if changes != nil {
   640→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   641→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   642→	}
   643→
   644→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   645→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   646→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint\n")
   647→		// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   648→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   649→		return nil
   650→	}
   651→
   652→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort, ignore errors)
   653→	transcript, _ := parseTranscript(input.TranscriptPath) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort extraction
   654→	checkpointUUID, _ := FindCheckpointUUID(transcript, input.ToolUseID)
   655→
   656→	// Get git author
   657→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   658→	if err != nil {
   659→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   660→	}
   661→
   662→	// Get the configured strategy
   663→	strat := GetStrategy()
   664→
   665→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place
   666→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   667→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   668→	}
   669→
   670→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   671→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   672→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   673→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   674→	}
   675→
   676→	// Build task checkpoint context - strategy handles metadata creation
   677→	// Note: Incremental checkpoints are now created during task execution via handleClaudeCodePostTodo,
   678→	// so we don't need to collect/cleanup staging area here.
   679→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   680→		SessionID:              input.SessionID,
   681→		ToolUseID:              input.ToolUseID,
   682→		AgentID:                input.AgentID,
   683→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   684→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   685→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   686→		TranscriptPath:         input.TranscriptPath,
   687→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   688→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   689→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   690→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   691→		SubagentType:           subagentType,
   692→		TaskDescription:        taskDescription,
   693→		AgentType:              agentType,
   694→	}
   695→
   696→	// Call strategy to save task checkpoint - strategy handles all metadata creation
   697→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   698→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task checkpoint: %w", err)
   699→	}
   700→
   701→	// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   702→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   703→
   704→	return nil
   705→}

   707→// handleClaudeCodeSessionStart handles the SessionStart hook for Claude Code.
   708→func handleClaudeCodeSessionStart() error {
   709→	return handleSessionStartCommon()
   710→}
   711→
   712→// handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd handles the SessionEnd hook for Claude Code.
   713→// This fires when the user explicitly closes the session.
   714→// Updates the session state with EndedAt timestamp.
   715→func handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd() error {
   716→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   717→	if err != nil {
   718→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookSessionEnd, os.Stdin)
   722→	if err != nil {
   723→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   724→	}
   725→
   726→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   727→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   728→		slog.String("hook", "session-end"),
   729→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   730→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   731→	)
   732→
   733→	if input.SessionID == "" {
   734→		return nil // No session to update
   735→	}
   736→
   737→	// Best-effort cleanup - don't block session closure on failure
   738→	if err := markSessionEnded(input.SessionID); err != nil {
   739→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to mark session ended: %v\n", err)
   740→	}
   741→	return nil
   742→}
   743→
   744→// transitionSessionTurnEnd fires EventTurnEnd to move the session from
   745→// ACTIVE → IDLE (or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE). Best-effort: logs warnings
   746→// on failure rather than returning errors.
   747→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID string) {
   748→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   749→	if loadErr != nil {
   750→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state for turn end: %v\n", loadErr)
   751→		return
   752→	}
   753→	if turnState == nil {
   754→		return
   755→	}
   756→	remaining := strategy.TransitionAndLog(turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
   757→
   758→	// Dispatch strategy-specific actions (e.g., ActionCondense for ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE)
   759→	if len(remaining) > 0 {
   760→		strat := GetStrategy()
   761→		if handler, ok := strat.(strategy.TurnEndHandler); ok {
   762→			if err := handler.HandleTurnEnd(turnState, remaining); err != nil {
   763→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end action dispatch failed: %v\n", err)
   764→			}
   765→		}
   766→	}
   767→
   768→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(turnState); updateErr != nil {
   769→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session phase on turn end: %v\n", updateErr)
   770→	}
   771→}
   772→
   773→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   774→func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
   775→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   776→	if err != nil {
   777→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   778→	}
   779→	if state == nil {
   780→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   781→	}
   782→
   783→	strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{})
   784→
   785→	now := time.Now()
   786→	state.EndedAt = &now
   787→
   788→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   789→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   790→	}
   791→	return nil
   792→}
   793→
   794→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   795→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   796→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   797→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   798→
   799→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   800→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   801→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   802→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   803→//
   804→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   805→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   806→//
   807→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   808→// with whatever data is available.
   809→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   810→	const (
   811→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   812→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   813→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   814→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   815→	)
   816→
   817→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   818→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   819→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   820→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   821→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   822→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   823→			)
   824→			return
   825→		}
   826→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   827→	}
   828→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   829→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   830→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   831→	)
   832→}
   833→
   834→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   835→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   836→// close to hookStartTime.
   837→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   838→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   839→	if err != nil {
   840→		return false
   841→	}
   842→	defer f.Close()
   843→
   844→	// Seek to tail
   845→	info, err := f.Stat()
   846→	if err != nil {
   847→		return false
   848→	}
   849→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   850→	if offset < 0 {
   851→		offset = 0
   852→	}
   853→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   854→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   855→		return false
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
   859→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
   860→	for _, line := range lines {
   861→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   862→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
   863→			continue
   864→		}
   865→
   866→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
   867→		var entry struct {
   868→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
   869→		}
   870→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
   871→			continue
   872→		}
   873→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
   874→		if err != nil {
   875→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
   876→			if err != nil {
   877→				continue
   878→			}
   879→		}
   880→
   881→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
   882→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
   883→			return true
   884→		}
   885→	}
   886→	return false
   887→}

    21→// createShadowBranchRef creates a shadow branch reference in the repo for
    22→// the given base commit and worktree ID. Uses an empty tree commit.
    23→func createShadowBranchRef(t *testing.T, repo *git.Repository, baseCommit, worktreeID string) {
    24→	t.Helper()
    25→
    26→	// Create empty tree
    27→	emptyTree := &object.Tree{Entries: []object.TreeEntry{}}
    28→	treeObj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
    29→	require.NoError(t, emptyTree.Encode(treeObj))
    30→	treeHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(treeObj)
    31→	require.NoError(t, err)
    32→
    33→	// Create commit
    34→	commitObj := &object.Commit{
    35→		Author:    object.Signature{Name: "test", Email: "test@test.com", When: time.Now()},
    36→		Committer: object.Signature{Name: "test", Email: "test@test.com", When: time.Now()},
    37→		Message:   "shadow checkpoint",
    38→		TreeHash:  treeHash,
    39→	}
    40→	enc := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
    41→	require.NoError(t, commitObj.Encode(enc))
    42→	commitHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(enc)
    43→	require.NoError(t, err)
    44→
    45→	// Create branch reference
    46→	branchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
    47→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(branchName)
    48→	ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
    49→	require.NoError(t, repo.Storer.SetReference(ref))
    50→}

    17→// TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop tests the "commit while agent is still working" flow.
    18→//
    19→// When the user commits while the agent is in the ACTIVE phase (between
    20→// SimulateUserPromptSubmit and SimulateStop), the session should transition to
    21→// ACTIVE_COMMITTED. This defers condensation because the agent is still working.
    22→// When the agent finishes its turn (SimulateStop), the deferred condensation fires
    23→// and the session transitions to IDLE with metadata persisted to entire/checkpoints/v1.
    24→//
    25→// State machine transitions tested:
    26→//   - ACTIVE + GitCommit -> ACTIVE_COMMITTED (defer condensation, migrate shadow branch)
    27→//   - ACTIVE_COMMITTED + TurnEnd -> IDLE + ActionCondense (deferred condensation fires)
    28→func TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop(t *testing.T) {
    29→	t.Parallel()
    30→
    31→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
    32→
    33→	// ========================================
    34→	// Phase 1: Start session and create initial checkpoint
    35→	// ========================================
    36→	t.Log("Phase 1: Start session and create initial work")
    37→
    38→	sess := env.NewSession()
    39→
    40→	// Pass transcript path in the hook input so it's stored in session state
    41→	// (needed for mid-session commit detection via live transcript)
    42→	submitWithTranscriptPath := func(sessionID, transcriptPath string) {
    43→		t.Helper()
    44→		input := map[string]string{
    45→			"session_id":      sessionID,
    46→			"transcript_path": transcriptPath,
    47→		}
    48→		inputJSON, _ := json.Marshal(input)
    49→		cmd := exec.Command(getTestBinary(), "hooks", "claude-code", "user-prompt-submit")
    50→		cmd.Dir = env.RepoDir
    51→		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(inputJSON)
    52→		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
    53→			"ENTIRE_TEST_CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="+env.ClaudeProjectDir,
    54→		)
    55→		if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
    56→			t.Fatalf("user-prompt-submit failed: %v\nOutput: %s", err, output)
    57→		}
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	submitWithTranscriptPath(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath)
    61→
    62→	// Verify session is ACTIVE
    63→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
    64→	if err != nil {
    65→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
    66→	}
    67→	if state == nil {
    68→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist")
    69→	}
    70→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActive {
    71→		t.Errorf("Phase after first prompt should be %q, got %q", session.PhaseActive, state.Phase)
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Create a file and transcript, then stop (first checkpoint)
    75→	env.WriteFile("feature.go", "package main\n\nfunc Feature() {}\n")
    76→	sess.CreateTranscript("Create feature function", []FileChange{
    77→		{Path: "feature.go", Content: "package main\n\nfunc Feature() {}\n"},
    78→	})
    79→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
    80→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (checkpoint 1) failed: %v", err)
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	// Verify session is IDLE after stop
    84→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
    85→	if err != nil {
    86→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
    87→	}
    88→	if state == nil {
    89→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist")
    90→	}
    91→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseIdle {
    92→		t.Errorf("Phase after first stop should be %q, got %q", session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
    93→	}
    94→	if state.StepCount != 1 {

    96→	}
    97→
    98→	// Verify shadow branch was created
    99→	initialHead := state.BaseCommit
   100→	shadowBranch := env.GetShadowBranchNameForCommit(initialHead)
   101→	if !env.BranchExists(shadowBranch) {
   102→		t.Fatalf("Shadow branch %s should exist after first checkpoint", shadowBranch)
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	// ========================================
   106→	// Phase 2: Start new turn and create more work
   107→	// ========================================
   108→	t.Log("Phase 2: Start new turn, create more work")
   109→
   110→	submitWithTranscriptPath(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath)
   111→
   112→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   113→	if err != nil {
   114→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   115→	}
   116→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActive {

   118→	}

   121→	env.WriteFile("utils.go", "package main\n\nfunc Util() {}\n")

   126→
   127→	// Do NOT stop yet -- the agent is still ACTIVE
   128→

   130→	// Phase 3: User commits while agent is ACTIVE

   132→	t.Log("Phase 3: User commits while agent is ACTIVE")
   133→
   134→	headBefore := env.GetHeadHash()
   135→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add feature and utils", "feature.go", "utils.go")
   136→	commitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   137→
   138→	if commitHash == headBefore {

   140→	}
   141→
   142→	// Verify checkpoint trailer was added
   143→	checkpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(commitHash)
   144→	if checkpointID == "" {

   146→	} else {
   147→		t.Logf("Commit has checkpoint trailer: %s", checkpointID)
   148→	}
   149→
   150→	// CRITICAL: Verify session phase is ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   151→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   152→	if err != nil {
   153→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   154→	}
   155→	if state == nil {
   156→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist after commit")
   157→	}
   158→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseActiveCommitted {
   159→		t.Errorf("Phase after commit-while-active should be %q, got %q",
   160→			session.PhaseActiveCommitted, state.Phase)
   161→	}
   162→	t.Logf("Session phase after mid-turn commit: %s", state.Phase)
   163→
   164→	// Verify shadow branch was migrated to the new HEAD
   165→	// The old shadow branch (based on initialHead) may still exist or be cleaned up.
   166→	// The important thing is that the session's BaseCommit was updated.
   167→	if state.BaseCommit == initialHead {
   168→		t.Logf("Note: BaseCommit not yet updated (may happen during migration)")
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	// ========================================
   172→	// Phase 4: Agent finishes turn (SimulateStop)
   173→	// ========================================
   174→	t.Log("Phase 4: Agent finishes turn (SimulateStop)")
   175→
   176→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   177→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (after commit) failed: %v", err)
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	// Verify session transitions to IDLE
   181→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(sess.ID)
   182→	if err != nil {
   183→		t.Fatalf("GetSessionState failed: %v", err)
   184→	}
   185→	if state == nil {
   186→		t.Fatal("Session state should exist after stop")
   187→	}
   188→	if state.Phase != session.PhaseIdle {
   189→		t.Errorf("Phase after stop from ACTIVE_COMMITTED should be %q, got %q",
   190→			session.PhaseIdle, state.Phase)
   191→	}
   192→	t.Logf("Session phase after stop: %s (StepCount: %d)", state.Phase, state.StepCount)
   193→
   194→	// Deferred condensation should have fired during TurnEnd (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE).
   195→	// Verify StepCount was reset and metadata was persisted to entire/checkpoints/v1.
   196→	if state.StepCount != 0 {
   197→		t.Errorf("StepCount should be 0 after TurnEnd condensation, got %d", state.StepCount)
   198→	}
   199→
   200→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   201→		t.Fatal("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after TurnEnd condensation")
   202→	}
   203→	latestCheckpointID := env.TryGetLatestCheckpointID()
   204→	if latestCheckpointID != "" {
   205→		summaryPath := CheckpointSummaryPath(latestCheckpointID)
   206→		if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, summaryPath) {
   207→			t.Errorf("Checkpoint metadata should exist at %s", summaryPath)
   208→		} else {

   210→		}
   211→	}

   213→	t.Log("CommitBeforeStop test completed successfully")
   214→}

   216→// TestShadow_AmendPreservesTrailer tests that `git commit --amend` preserves
   217→// the checkpoint trailer from the original commit.
   218→//
   219→// When a user amends a commit that has an Entire-Checkpoint trailer, the
   220→// prepare-commit-msg hook (called with source="commit") should preserve the
   221→// existing trailer. No duplicate condensation should occur.
   222→//
   223→// Hook behavior tested:
   224→//   - prepare-commit-msg with source="commit": preserves existing trailer
   225→//   - post-commit after amend: no duplicate condensation
   226→func TestShadow_AmendPreservesTrailer(t *testing.T) {
   227→	t.Parallel()
   228→
   229→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   230→
   231→	// ========================================
   232→	// Phase 1: Full workflow - create checkpoint and commit
   233→	// ========================================
   234→	t.Log("Phase 1: Create session, checkpoint, and commit")
   235→
   236→	sess := env.NewSession()
   237→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(sess.ID); err != nil {
   238→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	// Create a file and checkpoint
   242→	env.WriteFile("main.go", "package main\n\nfunc main() {}\n")
   243→	sess.CreateTranscript("Create main.go", []FileChange{
   244→		{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main\n\nfunc main() {}\n"},
   245→	})
   246→	if err := env.SimulateStop(sess.ID, sess.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   247→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Commit with hooks (triggers condensation)
   251→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Initial implementation", "main.go")
   252→
   253→	originalCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   254→	originalCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(originalCommitHash)
   255→	if originalCheckpointID == "" {
   256→		t.Fatal("Original commit should have a checkpoint trailer")
   257→	}
   258→	t.Logf("Original commit %s has checkpoint ID: %s", originalCommitHash[:7], originalCheckpointID)
   259→
   260→	// Verify condensation happened
   261→	if !env.BranchExists(paths.MetadataBranchName) {
   262→		t.Fatal("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch should exist after condensation")
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	// Record the sessions branch state for later comparison
   266→	sessionsCommitBefore := env.GetLatestCommitMessageOnBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   267→	t.Logf("Sessions branch commit before amend:\n%s", sessionsCommitBefore)
   268→
   269→	// ========================================
   270→	// Phase 2: Amend the commit
   271→	// ========================================
   272→	t.Log("Phase 2: Amend the commit")
   273→
   274→	// Amend with the same message (simulating a minor message edit or staging additional files)
   275→	env.GitCommitAmendWithShadowHooks("Initial implementation (amended)")
   276→
   277→	amendedCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   278→	t.Logf("Amended commit: %s", amendedCommitHash[:7])
   279→
   280→	// The amended commit hash should be different from the original
   281→	if amendedCommitHash == originalCommitHash {
   282→		t.Error("Amended commit should have a different hash")
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	// ========================================
   286→	// Phase 3: Verify trailer is preserved
   287→	// ========================================
   288→	t.Log("Phase 3: Verify checkpoint trailer is preserved")
   289→
   290→	amendedCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(amendedCommitHash)
   291→	if amendedCheckpointID == "" {
   292→		t.Fatal("Amended commit should still have a checkpoint trailer")
   293→	}
   294→	t.Logf("Amended commit has checkpoint ID: %s", amendedCheckpointID)
   295→
   296→	// The checkpoint ID should be the SAME as the original
   297→	if amendedCheckpointID != originalCheckpointID {
   298→		t.Errorf("Amended commit should preserve original checkpoint ID.\nOriginal: %s\nAmended:  %s",
   299→			originalCheckpointID, amendedCheckpointID)
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// ========================================
   303→	// Phase 4: Verify no duplicate condensation
   304→	// ========================================
   305→	t.Log("Phase 4: Verify no duplicate condensation")
   306→
   307→	// The sessions branch commit should not have changed (no new condensation)
   308→	sessionsCommitAfter := env.GetLatestCommitMessageOnBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName)

   313→		// if there's new content. But with no new session activity, it should be the same.
   314→		t.Log("Note: sessions branch was updated (may indicate duplicate condensation)")

   326→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, transcriptPath) {

   328→	}

   218→// TestShadowStrategy_LastCheckpointID_IgnoresOldSessions tests that when multiple
   219→// old sessions exist in the worktree, only the current session (matching BaseCommit)
   220→// is used for checkpoint ID reuse.
   221→//
   222→// This reproduces the bug where old session states from previous days would cause
   223→// different checkpoint IDs to be used when making multiple commits from a new session.
   224→func TestShadowStrategy_LastCheckpointID_IgnoresOldSessions(t *testing.T) {
   225→	t.Parallel()
   226→
   227→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   228→
   229→	// === Create an OLD session on the initial commit ===
   230→	oldSession := env.NewSession()
   231→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(oldSession.ID); err != nil {
   232→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (old session) failed: %v", err)
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	// Old session modifies a file
   236→	env.WriteFile("old.txt", "old session content")
   237→	oldSession.CreateTranscript("Create old file", []FileChange{
   238→		{Path: "old.txt", Content: "old session content"},
   239→	})
   240→
   241→	if err := env.SimulateStop(oldSession.ID, oldSession.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   242→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (old session) failed: %v", err)
   243→	}
   244→
   245→	// Commit from old session
   246→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Old session commit", "old.txt")
   247→	oldCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(env.GetHeadHash())
   248→	if oldCheckpointID == "" {
   249→		t.Fatal("Old session commit should have checkpoint ID")
   250→	}
   251→	t.Logf("Old session checkpoint ID: %s", oldCheckpointID)
   252→
   253→	// Make an intermediate commit (moves HEAD forward, creates new base for new session)
   254→	env.WriteFile("intermediate.txt", "unrelated change")
   255→	env.GitAdd("intermediate.txt")
   256→	env.GitCommit("Intermediate commit (no session)")
   257→
   258→	// === Create a NEW session on the new HEAD ===
   259→	newSession := env.NewSession()
   260→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(newSession.ID); err != nil {
   261→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (new session) failed: %v", err)
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// New session modifies two files
   265→	env.WriteFile("fileA.txt", "new session file A")
   266→	env.WriteFile("fileB.txt", "new session file B")
   267→	newSession.CreateTranscript("Create new files A and B", []FileChange{
   268→		{Path: "fileA.txt", Content: "new session file A"},
   269→		{Path: "fileB.txt", Content: "new session file B"},
   270→	})
   271→
   272→	if err := env.SimulateStop(newSession.ID, newSession.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   273→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop (new session) failed: %v", err)
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	// At this point, we have TWO session state files:
   277→	// - Old session: BaseCommit = old HEAD, LastCheckpointID = oldCheckpointID
   278→	// - New session: BaseCommit = current HEAD, FilesTouched = ["fileA.txt", "fileB.txt"]
   279→
   280→	// First commit from new session
   281→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file A from new session", "fileA.txt")
   282→	firstCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(env.GetHeadHash())
   283→	if firstCheckpointID == "" {
   284→		t.Fatal("First commit should have checkpoint ID")
   285→	}
   286→	t.Logf("First new session checkpoint ID: %s", firstCheckpointID)
   287→
   288→	// CRITICAL: First checkpoint should NOT be the old session's checkpoint
   289→	if firstCheckpointID == oldCheckpointID {
   290→		t.Errorf("First new session commit reused old session checkpoint ID %s (should generate new ID)",
   291→			oldCheckpointID)
   292→	}
   293→
   294→	// Second commit from new session
   295→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file B from new session", "fileB.txt")
   296→	secondCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(env.GetHeadHash())
   297→	if secondCheckpointID == "" {
   298→		t.Fatal("Second commit should have checkpoint ID")
   299→	}
   300→	t.Logf("Second new session checkpoint ID: %s", secondCheckpointID)
   301→
   302→	// CRITICAL: Both commits from new session should have SAME checkpoint ID
   303→	if firstCheckpointID != secondCheckpointID {
   304→		t.Errorf("New session commits should have same checkpoint ID:\n  First:  %s\n  Second: %s",
   305→			firstCheckpointID, secondCheckpointID)
   306→	}
   307→
   308→	// CRITICAL: Neither should be the old session's checkpoint ID
   309→	if secondCheckpointID == oldCheckpointID {
   310→		t.Errorf("Second new session commit reused old session checkpoint ID %s",
   311→			oldCheckpointID)
   312→	}
   313→}

   356→	}
   357→
   358→	// Verify data exists on entire/checkpoints/v1

   361→	if !env.FileExistsInBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, checkpointPath+"/"+paths.MetadataFileName) {
   362→		t.Error("Checkpoint metadata should exist on entire/checkpoints/v1 branch")

   394→	}
   395→
   396→	// First commit: file A (with hooks - triggers condensation)

   398→	firstCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()

   427→
   428→	// CRITICAL: Get session state after second commit

   437→	// REGRESSION TEST: BaseCommit must be updated even without condensation

   443→	}
   444→}

   466→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   467→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   468→
   469→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   470→	if err != nil {
   471→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   472→	}
   473→
   474→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   475→	head, err := repo.Head()
   476→	if err != nil {
   477→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   478→	}
   479→
   480→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   481→	if err != nil {
   482→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   483→	}
   484→
   485→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   486→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   487→	if !found {
   488→		// No trailer — user removed it or it was never added (mid-turn commit).
   489→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   490→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx, head)
   491→		return nil
   492→	}
   493→
   494→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   495→	if err != nil {
   496→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   500→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   501→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   502→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   503→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   504→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   505→		)
   506→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   507→	}
   508→
   509→	// Build transition context
   510→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   511→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   512→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   513→	}
   514→
   515→	if isRebase {
   516→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   517→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   518→		)
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   522→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   523→	// Track active sessions that were NOT condensed — their shadow branches must be preserved
   524→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   525→
   526→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   527→	committedFileSet := filesChangedInCommit(commit)
   528→
   529→	for _, state := range sessions {
   530→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   531→
   532→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   533→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   534→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   535→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   536→		if contentErr != nil {
   537→			hasNew = true
   538→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   539→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   540→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   541→			)
   542→		}
   543→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   544→
   545→		// Run the state machine transition
   546→		remaining := TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   547→
   548→		// Save FilesTouched BEFORE the action loop — condensation clears it,
   549→		// but we need the original list for carry-forward computation.
   550→		filesTouchedBefore := make([]string, len(state.FilesTouched))
   551→		copy(filesTouchedBefore, state.FilesTouched)
   552→
   553→		condensed := false
   554→
   555→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions.
   556→		// Each branch handles its own BaseCommit update so there is no
   557→		// fallthrough conditional at the end. On condensation failure,
   558→		// BaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated to preserve access to
   559→		// the shadow branch (which is named after the old BaseCommit).
   560→		for _, action := range remaining {
   561→			switch action {
   562→			case session.ActionCondense:
   563→				if hasNew {
   564→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   565→					condensed = true
   566→					// condenseAndUpdateState updates BaseCommit on success.
   567→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved so the shadow branch remains accessible.
   568→				} else {
   569→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   570→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   571→				}
   572→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   573→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   574→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   575→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   576→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   577→					s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   578→					condensed = true
   579→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved (same as ActionCondense).
   580→				} else {
   581→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   582→				}
   583→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   584→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   585→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   586→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   587→					)
   588→				}
   589→				s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   590→			case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   591→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above

   634→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),

   697→// updateBaseCommitIfChanged updates BaseCommit to newHead if it changed.
   698→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, newHead string) {
   699→	if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   700→		state.BaseCommit = newHead
   701→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: updated BaseCommit",
   702→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),

   707→
   708→// postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly updates BaseCommit for all sessions on the current
   709→// worktree when a commit has no Entire-Checkpoint trailer. This prevents BaseCommit
   710→// from going stale, which would cause future PrepareCommitMsg calls to skip the
   711→// session (BaseCommit != currentHeadHash filter).
   712→//
   713→// Unlike the full PostCommit flow, this does NOT fire EventGitCommit or trigger
   714→// condensation — it only keeps BaseCommit in sync with HEAD.
   715→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx context.Context, head *plumbing.Reference) {
   716→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   717→	if err != nil {
   718→		return // Silent failure — hooks must be resilient
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   722→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   723→		return
   724→	}
   725→
   726→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   727→	for _, state := range sessions {
   728→		// Only update active sessions. Idle/ended sessions are kept around for
   729→		// LastCheckpointID reuse and should not be advanced to HEAD.
   730→		if !state.Phase.IsActive() {
   731→			continue
   732→		}
   733→		if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   734→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit (no trailer): updating BaseCommit",
   735→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   736→				slog.String("old_base", truncateHash(state.BaseCommit)),
   737→				slog.String("new_head", truncateHash(newHead)),
   738→			)
   739→			state.BaseCommit = newHead
   740→			if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   741→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   742→			}
   743→		}
   744→	}
   745→}

   751→	}
   752→	return h
   753→}

Now I understand the carry-forward logic. Carry-forward only runs for **ACTIVE** sessions (agent still working during commit). For **IDLE** sessions (user commits after Stop), the second commit won't get a trailer — there's nothing to carry forward because the agent is done.

This means:
1. `ReusedAcrossCommits` — Tests IDLE reuse behavior, which is gone → **remove**
2. `BaseCommitUpdatedOnReuse` — Tests IDLE reuse + BaseCommit behavior → **rewrite as carry-forward test for ACTIVE sessions**  
3. `IgnoresOldSessions` — Second commit from new session won't have trailer in IDLE → **update assertions**

   356→	}
   357→
   358→	// Verify data exists on entire/checkpoints/v1

   366→// TestShadowStrategy_BaseCommitUpdatedOnReuse tests that BaseCommit is updated
   367→// even when a commit reuses a previous checkpoint ID (no new content to condense).
   368→// This prevents the stale BaseCommit bug where subsequent commits would fall back
   369→// to old sessions because no sessions matched the current HEAD.
   370→func TestShadowStrategy_BaseCommitUpdatedOnReuse(t *testing.T) {
   371→	t.Parallel()
   372→
   373→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   374→
   375→	// Create a session
   376→	session := env.NewSession()
   377→
   378→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID); err != nil {
   379→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
   380→	}
   381→
   382→	// Claude creates two files
   383→	env.WriteFile("fileA.txt", "content A")
   384→	env.WriteFile("fileB.txt", "content B")
   385→
   386→	session.CreateTranscript("Create files A and B", []FileChange{
   387→		{Path: "fileA.txt", Content: "content A"},
   388→		{Path: "fileB.txt", Content: "content B"},
   389→	})
   390→
   391→	// Stop (creates checkpoint on shadow branch)
   392→	if err := env.SimulateStop(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath); err != nil {
   393→		t.Fatalf("SimulateStop failed: %v", err)
   394→	}
   395→
   396→	// First commit: file A (with hooks - triggers condensation)
   397→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file A", "fileA.txt")
   398→	firstCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   399→	firstCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(firstCommitHash)
   400→	t.Logf("First commit (condensed): %s, checkpoint: %s", firstCommitHash[:7], firstCheckpointID)
   401→
   402→	// Get session state after first commit
   403→	state, err := env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
   404→	if err != nil {
   405→		t.Fatalf("Failed to get session state: %v", err)
   406→	}
   407→	baseCommitAfterFirst := state.BaseCommit
   408→	t.Logf("BaseCommit after first commit: %s", baseCommitAfterFirst[:7])
   409→
   410→	// Verify BaseCommit matches first commit
   411→	if !strings.HasPrefix(firstCommitHash, baseCommitAfterFirst) {
   412→		t.Errorf("BaseCommit after first commit should match HEAD: got %s, want prefix of %s",
   413→			baseCommitAfterFirst[:7], firstCommitHash[:7])
   414→	}
   415→
   416→	// Second commit: file B (reuse - no new content to condense)
   417→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file B", "fileB.txt")
   418→	secondCommitHash := env.GetHeadHash()
   419→	secondCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(secondCommitHash)
   420→	t.Logf("Second commit (reuse): %s, checkpoint: %s", secondCommitHash[:7], secondCheckpointID)
   421→
   422→	// Verify checkpoint IDs match (reuse is correct)
   423→	if firstCheckpointID != secondCheckpointID {
   424→		t.Errorf("Second commit should reuse first checkpoint ID: got %s, want %s",
   425→			secondCheckpointID, firstCheckpointID)
   426→	}
   427→
   428→	// CRITICAL: Get session state after second commit
   429→	// BaseCommit should be updated to second commit hash, not stay at first commit
   430→	state, err = env.GetSessionState(session.ID)
   431→	if err != nil {
   432→		t.Fatalf("Failed to get session state after second commit: %v", err)
   433→	}
   434→	baseCommitAfterSecond := state.BaseCommit
   435→	t.Logf("BaseCommit after second commit: %s", baseCommitAfterSecond[:7])
   436→
   437→	// REGRESSION TEST: BaseCommit must be updated even without condensation
   438→	// Before the fix, BaseCommit stayed at firstCommitHash after reuse commits
   439→	if !strings.HasPrefix(secondCommitHash, baseCommitAfterSecond) {
   440→		t.Errorf("BaseCommit after reuse commit should match HEAD: got %s, want prefix of %s\n"+
   441→			"This is a regression: BaseCommit was not updated after commit without condensation",
   442→			baseCommitAfterSecond[:7], secondCommitHash[:7])
   443→	}
   444→}

  1362→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
  1363→		parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1364→		if err != nil {
  1365→			return result
  1366→		}
  1367→		parentTree, err = parent.Tree()
  1368→		if err != nil {
  1369→			return result
  1370→		}
  1371→	}
  1372→
  1373→	if parentTree == nil {
  1374→		// Initial commit — all files are new
  1375→		if iterErr := commitTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
  1376→			result[f.Name] = struct{}{}
  1377→			return nil
  1378→		}); iterErr != nil {
  1379→			return result
  1380→		}
  1381→		return result
  1382→	}
  1383→
  1384→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1385→	if err != nil {
  1386→		return result
  1387→	}
  1388→	for _, change := range changes {
  1389→		name := change.To.Name
  1390→		if name == "" {
  1391→			name = change.From.Name
  1392→		}
  1393→		result[name] = struct{}{}
  1394→	}
  1395→	return result
  1396→}
  1397→
  1398→// subtractFiles returns files that are NOT in the exclude set.
  1399→func subtractFiles(files []string, exclude map[string]struct{}) []string {
  1400→	var remaining []string
  1401→	for _, f := range files {
  1402→		if _, excluded := exclude[f]; !excluded {
  1403→			remaining = append(remaining, f)
  1404→		}
  1405→	}
  1406→	return remaining
  1407→}
  1408→
  1409→// carryForwardToNewShadowBranch creates a new shadow branch at the current HEAD
  1410→// containing the remaining uncommitted files and all session metadata.
  1411→// This enables the next commit to get its own unique checkpoint.
  1412→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(
  1413→	logCtx context.Context,
  1414→	repo *git.Repository,
  1415→	state *SessionState,
  1416→	remainingFiles []string,
  1417→) {
  1418→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1419→
  1420→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(state.SessionID)
  1421→	metadataDirAbs := filepath.Join(state.WorktreePath, metadataDir)
  1422→
  1423→	result, err := store.WriteTemporary(context.Background(), checkpoint.WriteTemporaryOptions{
  1424→		SessionID:         state.SessionID,
  1425→		BaseCommit:        state.BaseCommit,
  1426→		WorktreeID:        state.WorktreeID,
  1427→		ModifiedFiles:     remainingFiles,
  1428→		MetadataDir:       metadataDir,
  1429→		MetadataDirAbs:    metadataDirAbs,
  1430→		CommitMessage:     "carry forward: uncommitted session files",
  1431→		IsFirstCheckpoint: false,
  1432→	})
  1433→	if err != nil {
  1434→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward failed",
  1435→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1436→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1437→		)
  1438→		return
  1439→	}
  1440→	if result.Skipped {
  1441→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward skipped (no changes)",
  1442→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1443→		)
  1444→		return
  1445→	}
  1446→
  1447→	// Update state for the carry-forward checkpoint.
  1448→	// CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0 is intentional: prompt-level carry-forward means
  1449→	// the next condensation re-processes the full transcript so the checkpoint is self-contained.
  1450→	state.FilesTouched = remainingFiles
  1451→	state.StepCount = 1
  1452→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0
  1453→	state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1454→
  1455→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-commit: carried forward remaining files",
  1456→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1457→		slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1458→	)
  1459→}

   320→
   321→#### Session Package (`cmd/entire/cli/session/`)
   322→- `session.go` - Session data types and interfaces
   323→- `state.go` - `StateStore` for managing `.git/entire-sessions/` files
   324→- `phase.go` - Session phase state machine (phases, events, transitions, actions)
   325→
   326→#### Session Phase State Machine
   327→
   328→Sessions track their lifecycle through phases managed by a state machine in `session/phase.go`:
   329→
   330→**Phases:** `ACTIVE`, `ACTIVE_COMMITTED`, `IDLE`, `ENDED`
   331→
   332→**Events:**
   333→- `TurnStart` - Agent begins a turn (UserPromptSubmit hook)
   334→- `TurnEnd` - Agent finishes a turn (Stop hook)
   335→- `GitCommit` - A git commit was made (PostCommit hook)
   336→- `SessionStart` - New session started
   337→- `SessionStop` - Session explicitly stopped
   338→
   339→**Key transitions:**
   340→- `IDLE + TurnStart → ACTIVE` - Agent starts working
   341→- `ACTIVE + TurnEnd → IDLE` - Agent finishes turn
   342→- `ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE_COMMITTED` - User commits while agent is working (condensation deferred)
   343→- `ACTIVE_COMMITTED + TurnEnd → IDLE` - Agent finishes after commit (condense now)
   344→- `IDLE + GitCommit → IDLE` - User commits between turns (condense immediately)
   345→- `ENDED + GitCommit → ENDED` - Post-session commit (condense if files touched)
   346→
   347→The state machine emits **actions** (e.g., `ActionCondense`, `ActionMigrateShadowBranch`, `ActionDeferCondensation`) that hook handlers dispatch to strategy-specific implementations.
   348→
   349→#### Metadata Structure
   350→
   351→**Shadow Strategy** - Shadow branches (`entire/<commit-hash[:7]>-<worktreeHash[:6]>`):
   352→```
   353→.entire/metadata/<session-id>/
   354→├── full.jsonl               # Session transcript
   355→├── prompt.txt               # User prompts
   356→├── context.md               # Generated context
   357→└── tasks/<tool-use-id>/     # Task checkpoints
   358→    ├── checkpoint.json      # UUID mapping for rewind
   359→    └── agent-<id>.jsonl     # Subagent transcript

   557→func TestPostCommit_CondensationFailure_EndedSession_PreservesShadowBranch(t *testing.T) {

   581→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   582→
   583→	// Corrupt shadow branch by pointing it at ZeroHash
   584→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   585→	corruptRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch), plumbing.ZeroHash)
   586→	require.NoError(t, repo.Storer.SetReference(corruptRef))

   613→// TestTurnEnd_Active_NoActions verifies that HandleTurnEnd with no actions

   615→func TestTurnEnd_Active_NoActions(t *testing.T) {

   648→
   649→	// Verify state is unchanged

   661→}

  "content": "# 1:1 Checkpoint-to-Commit Model — Session Summary\n\nBranch: `soph/one-to-one-checkpoints`\n\n## What changed\n\nThis session replaced the old 1:N checkpoint reuse model with a 1:1 model where every user commit gets its own unique checkpoint ID. Previously, multiple commits could share a single checkpoint ID via `LastCheckpointID` reuse. Now, each commit generates a fresh checkpoint, and uncommitted files are carried forward to a new shadow branch.\n\n**Net result: 664 insertions, 1,460 deletions across 25 files.**\n\n## Core changes\n\n### 1. Removed `ACTIVE_COMMITTED` phase\n\nThe session state machine was simplified from 4 phases to 3:\n\n- **Before:** `ACTIVE`, `ACTIVE_COMMITTED`, `IDLE`, `ENDED`\n- **After:** `ACTIVE`, `IDLE`, `ENDED`\n\nThe `ACTIVE + GitCommit` transition now stays `ACTIVE` and condenses immediately (no more deferred condensation). This removed `ActionDeferCondensation`, `ActionMigrateShadowBranch`, and the two-pass PostCommit architecture.\n\n**Files:** `session/phase.go`, `session/phase_test.go`, `session/state.go`\n\n### 2. Prompt-level carry-forward\n\nWhen an ACTIVE session has more files touched than were committed, the remaining files are carried forward to a new shadow branch at the new HEAD. This ensures the next commit can get its own unique checkpoint.\n\nThree new helper functions:\n- `filesChangedInCommit()` — diffs a commit against its parent to identify committed files\n- `subtractFiles()` — computes the set difference (touched - committed)\n- `carryForwardToNewShadowBranch()` — creates a new shadow branch with remaining files and resets state for the next checkpoint cycle\n\n**File:** `strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go`\n\n### 3. Simplified PostCommit\n\nThe PostCommit handler was rewritten from a two-pass architecture (pass 1: condense + track, pass 2: deferred condensation) to a single-pass model. Every session condenses immediately on `GitCommit`, and carry-forward handles any remaining files.\n\nRemoved:\n- `handleActiveCommittedTurnEnd()` and deferred condensation logic\n- `hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch()` helper\n- `LastCheckpointID` reuse path in `PrepareCommitMsg`\n\n**File:** `strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go` (493 lines changed, net deletion)\n\n### 4. TurnID generation\n\nAdded `TurnID` (12-hex-char random ID via `id.Generate()`) to session state, generated at every turn start. This correlates all checkpoints within a single agent turn for aggregation/deduplication.\n\n- Manual-commit: already had TurnID (set in `initializeSession` and `InitializeSession`)\n- Auto-commit: **newly added** — both new session and re-prompt paths now set TurnID\n\n**Files:** `strategy/manual_commit_session.go`, `strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go`, `strategy/auto_commit.go`\n\n### 5. `TurnID` field on `CommittedMetadata`\n\nAdded `TurnID` to the checkpoint metadata written to `entire/checkpoints/v1`, so condensed checkpoints carry the turn correlation ID.\n\n**Files:** `checkpoint/checkpoint.go`, `checkpoint/committed.go`, `strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go`\n\n## Test changes\n\n### New tests\n- `TestSubtractFiles` — table-driven unit test (5 subtests) for the `subtractFiles` helper\n- `TestFilesChangedInCommit` — verifies correct diff against parent commit\n- `TestFilesChangedInCommit_InitialCommit` — handles no-parent edge case\n- `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_CarryForward_PartialCommit` — partial commit carries forward remaining files\n- `TestPostCommit_ActiveSession_CarryForward_AllCommitted` — full commit has no carry-forward\n- TurnID assertion added to `TestInitializeSession_SetsPhaseActive`\n\n### Rewritten tests\n- `last_checkpoint_id_test.go` — 3 tests rewritten from 1:N reuse behavior to 1:1 model behavior\n- `phase_transitions_test.go` — assertions updated from `ACTIVE_COMMITTED` to `ACTIVE`\n- `phase_postcommit_test.go` — all PostCommit tests updated for immediate condensation model\n\n### Deleted tests\n- `TestClassifySession_ActiveCommittedStale` and `TestClassifySession_ActiveCommittedRecent_Healthy` (doctor)\n- `TestMarkSessionEnded_ActiveCommittedToEnded` (phase wiring)\n- `TestMidTurnCommit_*` tests (replaced by carry-forward tests)\n- `TestPrepareCommitMsg_ReusesLastCheckpointID_*` tests (1:N reuse no longer exists)\n- `setupSessionWithFileChange` unused helper\n\n## Documentation\n\n- **CLAUDE.md** updated: removed `ACTIVE_COMMITTED` from phase list, updated transitions to show `ACTIVE + GitCommit → ACTIVE` with immediate condensation, replaced stale action names (`ActionMigrateShadowBranch`, `ActionDeferCondensation`) with current ones (`ActionCondense`, `ActionUpdateLastInteraction`)\n- Comments updated across `doctor.go`, `reset.go`, `strategy.go`, `hooks.go`, `hooks_claudecode_handlers.go` to remove ACTIVE_COMMITTED references\n\n## Cleanup\n\n- Removed unused `hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch` function\n- Removed unused `setupSessionWithFileChange` test helper\n- Removed `PendingCheckpointID` field from session state\n- Removed `LastCheckpointID` reuse path from PrepareCommitMsg\n"
